notes: set_drop_pools give the sets a content source can roll; weights are the row counts item_set_rate lists per pool, so probability is uniform over rows.
stat_scales are equip_stat val_min/val_max ranges keyed by the main_stat / sub_stat ids on equipment rows.
materials exclude cosmetic item_material types; the full table stays in datamine/raw/tables/item_material.json.

gear_sets.description: Speed increases by 25%.

gear_sets.description: Critical Hit Damage increases by 60%.

gear_sets.description: Absorbs 20% of damage dealt as Health.

gear_sets.name: Counter Set
gear_sets.description: 30% chance to counterattack when attacked.

gear_sets.name: Unity Set
gear_sets.description: Increases Dual Attack chance by 8%.

gear_sets.name: Immunity Set
gear_sets.description: Grants the caster immunity for 1 turn at the beginning of the battle. Does not stack with similar effects.

gear_sets.name: Rage Set
gear_sets.description: Damage dealt increases by 30% when attacking debuffed targets.

gear_sets.name: Revenge Set
gear_sets.description: Speed increases by 12%, and for every 1% of Health lost, Speed increases by an additional 0.5%.

gear_sets.name: Injury Set
gear_sets.description: After attacking, decreases the target's max Health equal to damage dealt, by up to 6% (12% when using Single Attack).

gear_sets.name: Penetration Set
gear_sets.description: When attacking with a Single Attack, penetrates the target's Defense by 15%. Does not stack with other sets of the same name.

gear_sets.name: Protection Set
gear_sets.description: At the start of battle, grants a barrier equivalent to 12% of the caster's max Health to all allies for 2 turns.

gear_sets.name: Torrent Set
gear_sets.description: Decreases Health by 10%, and when attacking, increases damage dealt by 10%.

gear_sets.name: Reversal Set
gear_sets.description: Increases Speed by 15%. Upon reviving, increases Combat Readiness by 50%.

gear_sets.name: Riposte Set
gear_sets.description: After successfully evading, has a 70% chance to counterattack.

gear_sets.name: Warfare Set
gear_sets.description: Increases Health by 20%. At the start of battle, resets skill cooldowns.

gear_sets.name: Pursuit Set
gear_sets.description: Increases additional damage dealt by 20%. Does not stack with other sets of the same name.

gear_sets.name: Weakening Set
gear_sets.description: Increases Speed by 15%. Increases the chance to inflict debuffs by 15%.

gear_sets.name: Fervor Set
gear_sets.description: At the start of an extra turn, increases the damage of the next attack by 20%. Does not stack with other sets of the same name.

equipment.name: Light of a Million
equipment.description: A million lights were released asking for aid. To those heroes who answered that call, a token of thanks.

equipment.name: Pendant of Luminescence
equipment.description: A pendant with all the memories from a glorious moment of a hero's adventure.

equipment.name: Verdant Boots
equipment.description: Mysterious boots that remember the countless steps taken by an Heir who devoted their life to protecting the peace of Orbis.

equipment.name: Hat of Small Miracles
equipment.description: You find a scribble from Arky. You have to do little things like this when doing good deeds! Kyuu!

equipment.name: Socks of Small Miracles
equipment.description: You find Arky's memo. Humans who don't have fluffy fur like Arky should wear something like this!

equipment.name: Thorn Vine Whip
equipment.description: A present given by Lidica as an apology. She's clueless about giving gifts, so she settled for something she likes.

equipment.name: High-End Clothing
equipment.description: Luxurious clothing from Bellona. It looks so expensive that no one would dare to pick a fight with someone wearing it.

equipment.name: Rose Coronet
equipment.description: A coronet that Aither made with roses from the garden. Watch out for thorns.

equipment.name: Lucky Amulet
equipment.description: According to Achates, these are cross-shaped accessories that symbolize the Church of the Goddess and bring good luck.

equipment.name: Oath Ring
equipment.description: A ring with a small ruby, once given to Jena. They say red jewels represent promises made with blood.

equipment.name: Coat of Small Miracles
equipment.description: As you put on the coat, you can hear Arky's voice saying "you can still get cold even if you're covered with fur, kyu!"

equipment.name: A Small and Violent Miracle
equipment.description: Presents are for good boys and girls only! I'm going to punish anyone who tries to steal them!

equipment.name: Angelica's Scarf
equipment.description: A Christmas gift from Angelica. It is exceptionally warm and light.

equipment.name: Mercedes's Scarf
equipment.description: The first scarf made by Mercedes after she learned how to knit. Though a little loose, it is undeniably cozy.

equipment.name: Karin's Scarf
equipment.description: A beloved scarf of Karin's that she received as a free gift for purchasing a box of Christmas doughnuts.

equipment.name: Destina's Scarf
equipment.description: A scarf woven by Spirits who were worried Destina may catch a cold in her new Human body. It shines softly by itself.

equipment.name: Krau's Scarf
equipment.description: A scarf Krau lost after drinking. You tried to return it to him, but he told you to keep it.

equipment.name: Iseria's Scarf
equipment.description: Iseria's snowy white scarf. She wears it everywhere but refuses to admit who gave it to her.

equipment.name: Blessing of Lunaris
equipment.description: A ring engraved with the path of the goddess Lunaris as she moves quietly across the sky of Orbis.

equipment.name: Witchaven's Candy Wand
equipment.description: A dessert-shaped magic wand designed in Witchaven to celebrate the festival.

equipment.name: Perland's Luxury Coat
equipment.description: A luxurious coat delicately stitched by a master artisan from Perland to celebrate the festival.

equipment.name: Meldrec's Heart Hood
equipment.description: A hood decorated with heart shapes made in Meldrec to celebrate the festival.

equipment.name: Aahken's Golden Wing Boots
equipment.description: A pair of golden-winged boots designed in Aahken to celebrate the festival.

equipment.name: Constella's Pearl Necklace
equipment.description: A necklace of natural pearls with a star-shaped decoration designed in Constella to celebrate the festival.

equipment.name: Sunset Skystone Ring
equipment.description: A rare, expensive ring made with a Sunset Skystone.

equipment.name: Sword of Radiant Promise
equipment.description: A high-quality sword specially created for Heirs who have decided to set out for adventure once again.

equipment.name: Armor of Radiant Promise
equipment.description: A high-quality armor specially created for Heirs who have decided to set out for adventure once again.

equipment.name: Helmet of Radiant Promise
equipment.description: A high-quality helmet specially created for Heirs who have decided to set out for adventure once again.

equipment.name: Boots of Radiant Promise
equipment.description: A high-quality pair of boots specially created for Heirs who have decided to set out for adventure once again.

equipment.name: Pendant of Radiant Promise
equipment.description: The back of the pendant is engraved with the phrase, "With a welcoming heart."

equipment.name: Ring of Radiant Promise
equipment.description: The inside of the ring is engraved with the phrase, "Always remember our promises."

equipment.name: Returned Protector's Hostility
equipment.description: As the protector of life placed down their weapon, they did not think of returning.

equipment.name: Returned Protector's Heart
equipment.description: Could this armor designed to protect the body also protect the heart? The protector pondered.

equipment.name: Returned Protector's Will
equipment.description: Many things took place before the protector returned to take up the helm filled with their noble will.

equipment.name: Returned Protector's Footsteps
equipment.description: The worn-out heels of these boots show evidence of the protector's wandering travels.

equipment.name: Blessing of Rediscovered Life
equipment.description: A magical amulet that holds the deep emotions of recovering one's lost life.

equipment.name: Symbol of Renewed Vows
equipment.description: A ring that holds the strong volition to never say goodbye.

equipment.name: Ring of Old Oaths
equipment.description: A ring worn by the late king of Taranor. It is all Sigret has left of him.

equipment.name: Water Gun
equipment.description: A toy gun that shoots water. Schuri sells them at a street stall on the beaches of Reingar.

equipment.name: Proof of Determination
equipment.description: Even after innumerable trials and tribulations, the wearer's determination is still as strong as it was the day they first put this necklace on.

equipment.name: Evidence of Lasting Endurance
equipment.description: A ring covered in marks and scratches that hint at the pain and hardships its wearer went through.

equipment.name: Helmet with Erased Code Number
equipment.description: A helmet that belongs to the leader of the Mechanical Special Forces. The code number printed on it to identify the owner has been removed.

equipment.name: Paradia's Perseverance
equipment.description: The clothes Politis used to wear in the laboratory on Paradia. They remind her of those days, and now she wears them every day on Orbis as well.

equipment.name: Fruits of Alliance
equipment.description: A weapon made by modifying an Aakhen crossbow. It is decorated with each city's unique gemstone.

equipment.name: Conversation and Persuasion
equipment.description: A pair of gauntlets that Rose used to wear. She named the right one as "Conversation," and the left as "Persuasion."

equipment.name: The Result of Trust
equipment.description: A necklace made with the combined essence of all three race's technologies. It is engraved with a statement wishing for peace in the North.

equipment.name: Kise's Crystal Bracelet
equipment.description: A bracelet adorned with iridescent crystals. It's filled with the resolve to stand by the Heir's side in protecting this world.

equipment.name: Ruele's Camellia Pendant
equipment.description: A pendant made of unwithering camellia that holds the blessings and prayers of the Spirit Lord of Light.

equipment.name: Ezera Royal Castle Brooch
equipment.description: A brooch evocative of special connections, created in celebration of Foundation Day. It bears the spirit of gratitude and wishes for peace.

equipment.name: Protective Oath

equipment.name: Lucky Ceramic Necklace
equipment.description: A necklace crafted with a tiny ceramic ornament from the special New Year's pie. It is said to possess the power to make one's wish come true.

equipment.name: Lapis of Protection Amulet
equipment.description: An amulet created by a Nocturne, imbued with their wish to protect those they hold dear.

equipment.name: Ring of Wishes
equipment.description: A ring crafted by Cermia herself. Rumor has it that this ring is imbued with a special power that grants wishes. Of course, it's just another white lie Cermia made up.

equipment.name: Mystic Dagger
equipment.description: A dagger to subdue the Wicked. It's imbued with the mysterious power of the Great Wicked.

equipment.name: Vestigia
equipment.description: A fragrance crafted by Byblis, the perfumer. Its wearer unknowingly reveals their location to her.

equipment.name: Moonshade Blade First Quarter
equipment.description: One half of the twin blades used by the Moon Assassins, First Quarter. It harbors a sharp murderous intent.

equipment.name: Moonshade Blade Last Quarter
equipment.description: One half of the twin blades used by the Moon Assassins, Last Quarter. It harbors a sharp murderous aura.

equipment.name: Mana Drake Bonesword
equipment.description: A sword sharpened with the bones of a mana drake.

equipment.name: Mana Drake Hide Tunic
equipment.description: Leather armor containing the essence of a magical swamp creature.

equipment.name: Mana Drake Mask
equipment.description: A helm containing the essence of a magical swamp creature.

equipment.name: Mana Drake Boots
equipment.description: Boots containing the essence of a magical swamp creature.

equipment.name: Frost Claw Necklace
equipment.description: An amulet made from a frost gem passed down through generations of the Nixied Clan.

equipment.name: Blue Dragon Gem

equipment.name: Durable Swimming Fins

equipment.name: Sparkling Seashore Necklace

equipment.name: Adorable Seashore Bracelet

equipment.name: Sword of a Leader
equipment.description: The leader fell silent as they reflected on all the effects their use of this sword might have on the world.

equipment.name: Armor of a Leader
equipment.description: Armor forged by the leader before a long journey, in preparation to achieve what they set out to do.

equipment.name: Helmet of a Leader
equipment.description: The leader never ceased agonizing over what is good and what is evil.

equipment.name: Boots of a Leader
equipment.description: These boots encouraged the leader to take a step on an unfamiliar path toward the answer they sought.

equipment.name: Brave Suin Warrior's Sword
equipment.description: A longsword forged by the Markus Merchant Guild using a secret method passed down among the Morai.

equipment.name: Bejeweled Suit
equipment.description: A suit sold by the Nehenqui Merchant Guild. The authenticity of the jewels it is decorated with should probably be verified.

equipment.name: Exquisite Sandstorm Helm
equipment.description: An extremely expensive helm forged by the Afih Merchant Guild using high-quality materials.

equipment.name: Traveler's Sand Boots
equipment.description: Waterproof, air-permeable boots specially crafted by the Basar Merchant Guild.

equipment.name: Desert Horizon Necklace
equipment.description: A necklace made by the Nisa Merchant Guild, popular for its unique design.

equipment.name: Desert Light Bracelet
equipment.description: A bracelet made by the Nonori Merchant Guild, favored by everyone for its elegant design.

equipment.name: Weapon of Destiny
equipment.description: We'll never lose our firm resolve to protect our dear friends and reliable colleagues.

equipment.name: Helmet of Destiny
equipment.description: We remained in each other's memories of the past and hopes for the future, and that is what allowed us to meet again.

equipment.name: Armor of Destiny
equipment.description: The adventure that led us to save the world sprouted from the small seed of bravery planted within our hearts.

equipment.name: Boots of Destiny
equipment.description: After following the trail left behind by our connection to others, we finally discovered our destinies.

equipment.description: An orb that holds the power of a winter night, made to commemorate the Constellan Snowflake Festival.

equipment.name: Snowfield Crown

equipment.name: Warmth of the Stars

equipment.name: Protection of the Stars
equipment.description: Boots specially made for Constella's priests and priestess.

equipment.name: Seraphic Judge's Spear
equipment.description: A spear forged by a blacksmith known for their grumpy attitude yet highly dexterous handiwork.

equipment.name: Seraphic Judge's Helm
equipment.description: A helmet with good heat retention due to the pelt inside of it.

equipment.name: Seraphic Judge's Armor
equipment.description: A set of heavy armor. It is a highly sought-after piece, but not everyone can bear its weight.

equipment.name: Seraphic Judge's Boots
equipment.description: A special pair of boots that can alter its shape to fit the wearer's gait.

equipment.name: Seraphic Judge's Promise
equipment.description: A ring that is rumored to show illusions of judgment to the wearer when they close their eyes.

equipment.name: Seraphic Judge's Oath
equipment.description: A pendant with a message on the back that reads, "For salvation upon this evil world."

equipment.name: Lustrous Spirit's Sword

equipment.name: Lustrous Spirit's Protection
equipment.description: A helmet that whispers encouragement to the wearer.

equipment.name: Lustrous Spirit's Armor
equipment.description: A piece of armor that protects the wearer's heart from deadly attacks.

equipment.name: Lustrous Spirit's Boots
equipment.description: A pair of boots that keeps the wearer's feet from being tired even after a long walk.

equipment.name: Lustrous Spirit's Promise
equipment.description: A ring with a small inscription inside that reads, "For Everyone's Life."

equipment.name: Lustrous Spirit's Oath
equipment.description: A pendant that encases an indestructible gemstone.

equipment.name: Snowflower Ring
equipment.description: A transparent ring with a snowflake-shaped gem, made to commemorate the Constellan Snowflake Festival.

equipment.name: Starry Clock
equipment.description: A clock pendant engraved with stars, made to commemorate the Constellan Snowflake Festival.

equipment.name: Scented Hairpin
equipment.description: A hairpin Rem made after seeing the flowers around Tirel Castle. It has an elaborate design and seems as if it's scented.

equipment.name: Knit Brooch
equipment.description: A flower-shaped brooch that Emilia knitted to give as a heartfelt gift.

equipment.name: Lucky Eye Bracelet
equipment.description: A knotted bracelet decorated with a lucky gemstone. It is said that it keeps misfortune away.

equipment.name: Seafarer's Harpoon
equipment.description: Don't waste my time asking, "Haven't we met before?" I'm busy chasing after something!

equipment.description: I’d like to sit on the beach wearing this shirt as I gaze upon a beautiful sunset with a refreshing drink in my hand.

equipment.name: Nostalgic Summer Sandals
equipment.description: The hot sand, a scorching summer sun, my indomitable spirit that never takes the easy way out, and these summer sandals that remind me of fond summer memories.

equipment.name: Morale Ring
equipment.description: A limited-edition ring made to commemorate the Full Moon Harvest Festival. Only participants who performed well enough in the contest are able to receive one.

equipment.name: Flame of the Full Moon
equipment.description: A necklace comprised of mysterious colors that is crafted every full moon. It's said that wearing this necklace wards off any incidents that may happen during a full moon.

equipment.name: Gift Grandma's Cane
equipment.description: A cane used by the Winter Gift Grandma in a fairy tale. She mercilessly swings this cane when she sees someone harassing children.

equipment.name: Warmth of a Snowflake
equipment.description: A hat made by the people of Arimelka for the harsh winter. It is known for its strong insulation.

equipment.name: Heated Cloak
equipment.description: A cloak designed by Rose and Nemunas, given to the people of Arimelka.

equipment.name: Deer Steps
equipment.description: A pair of boots made in Wintenberg with water-resistant materials.

equipment.name: Snowflake Ring
equipment.description: A ring that is said to have been forged by a master craftsman who lived in Arimelka in the past.

equipment.name: Promise of Silence
equipment.description: A necklace embracing an ore that is rarely harvested on cliffs. It does not break even upon strong impact.

equipment.name: Proof of Victory
equipment.description: A heavy crown awarded to the one who ascends the throne after surviving the severe competition and animosity.

equipment.name: Friendship Ring
equipment.description: A handicraft from a Solayu gift shop. The girls bought five of them, and each has a different color.

equipment.name: Exceptional Long Spear

equipment.name: Mechanic's Kerchief

equipment.name: Alchemist's Pocket Watch

equipment.name: E7WC 2022 Champion's Ring
equipment.description: A ring awarded to 銀色の幻影 (Phantom), the champion of the E7WC 2022. This ring contains the power to guide the bearer to make the best decisions.

equipment.name: Sword of Light
equipment.description: ae-WINTER's favorite longsword among her arsenal.

equipment.name: Star Snow Pendant
equipment.description: A pendant decorated with ae-WINTER's symbol of the star.

equipment.name: Butterfly Gem Goggles
equipment.description: ae-NINGNING's goggles that exhibit her artistic flair.

equipment.name: Butterfly Effect Ring
equipment.description: A ring decorated with ae-NINGNING's symbol of the butterfly.

equipment.name: Sparkle Jacket
equipment.description: ae-GISELLE's jacket that sparkles even from afar.

equipment.name: Moonlight Pendant
equipment.description: A pendant decorated with ae-GISELLE's symbol of the moon.

equipment.name: Neon Boots
equipment.description: ae-KARINA's boots that are enveloped in neon light.

equipment.name: Heart Ring
equipment.description: A ring decorated with ae-KARINA's symbol of the heart.

equipment.name: Token of Affection
equipment.description: A set of promise rings embellished with jade. One is in the shape of a dragon, and the other a flower.

equipment.name: Rimuru's Sword
equipment.description: A straight sword wielded by Rimuru.

equipment.name: Benimaru's Clothes
equipment.description: An attire that is both elegant and tensile, well suited for the Commander-in-Chief. Not only does he wear this as casual attire, but he also wears it in combat.

equipment.name: Judgment of Peace
equipment.description: A weapon forged in order to solve the conflict within the Perlutia family long ago.

equipment.name: Wild Flower Brooch
equipment.description: A brooch prepared by Achates as an end of the year gift. It resembles the flower she gave to her older sister 10 years ago.

equipment.name: Sweets & Music Mic
equipment.description: A custom mic Maid Chloe gifted to the members of Miracle Maid Kingdom for the Sweets & Music performance.

equipment.name: Shrieking Flute
equipment.description: A flute to repel dangerous creatures living in the desert

equipment.name: Panoramic Goggles
equipment.description: Goggles that protect your eyes from raging sandstorms

equipment.name: Sun Swallowing Necklace
equipment.description: A necklace symbolizing the scorching desert sun. At night, its gemstone glows like watchful eyes.

equipment.name: Floral Sun Hat
equipment.description: Frida's treasured hat, which she wears all the time because she thinks it makes her look mature and elegant. She decorated it with fake flowers to cover the crudely mended areas.

equipment.name: Pinecone Necklace
equipment.description: A necklace adorned with pinecones from the Friendship Tree planted by Young Senya and Alencia. Within it lies the pure dream of two children who wished to remain friends for eternity.

equipment.name: Dingy Convenience Store Uniform Vest
equipment.description: A uniform vest Tori wears at her convenience store job. It's a hand-me-down from Luluca after she quit.

equipment.name: Premium Waterproof Bag
equipment.description: A waterproof bag bought solely for this coming bootcamp. It’s lightweight and sturdy.

equipment.name: Sura Helmet

equipment.name: Sporty Crop Jersey

equipment.name: Strapped Wedge Sandals

equipment.name: Two-tone Aquatic Leisure Gloves

equipment.name: Golden Buckle Choker

equipment.name: Frieren’s Suitcase

equipment.name: Frieren’s Muffler
equipment.description: A muffler you just can’t do without during the cold winters. It’s tied in an adorable ribbon.

equipment.name: Stark’s Clothes
equipment.description: The clothes that Stark wears. It’s made to be comfortable to move in.

equipment.name: Fern’s Mirrored Lotus Bracelet
equipment.description: A bracelet that Fern received from Stark as a birthday present. Stark picked it out for her himself.

equipment.name: Legendary Grimoire
equipment.description: A legendary-grade grimoire once kept by the chief of a village far out in the countryside. One can learn the magic of keeping the beer’s head from overflowing.

equipment.name: Blue-Gemmed Hair Brooch
equipment.description: A hair brooch decorated with a blue gem encased in a silver frame. It’s great to keep one’s hair tidy.

equipment.name: Artisan’s Long Boots
equipment.description: A pair of long boots crafted with meticulous care. Not only is it light and sturdy but it’s also easy on the feet.

equipment.name: Reverie’s Flower Decoration
equipment.description: A decoration crafted from a flower that bloomed within forgotten memories. It's said to allow one to feel the lingering scent of dreams once dreamt.

equipment.name: Reverie’s Ring
equipment.description: A ring that holds mysterious light and guides the way through dim dreamscapes.

equipment.name: Cozy Oven Mitt
equipment.description: An oven mitt the Old Baker gave to Young Senya, who wished to surprise her friend with bread she baked on her own.

equipment.name: Well-Crafted Leather Boots
equipment.description: Boots once worn by the blacksmith of Arimelka Village. Judging by their small size, they would likely fit Alencia perfectly.

equipment.name: Camera of Desire

equipment.name: Coral Horn
equipment.description: A coral horn flowing with an alien power. It becomes a catalyst that erupts latent desires.

equipment.name: Summer Vacation Shawl
equipment.description: A shawl prepared for a summer vacation. It protects sensitive skin from strong sunlight.

equipment.name: Aquamarine Winged Shoes

equipment.name: Summer Grain Gloves

equipment.description: Another eye that reflects desires not outwardly revealed. It awakens the wearer's abilities according to the density of the desire.

artifacts.description: A dark egg containing demonic energy. Nobody knows what it may contain inside.

artifacts.name: Prophetic Candlestick
artifacts.description: It is said that you can see into the future by lighting a candle, putting it on this candlestick, and looking into the flame.

artifacts.name: Ancient Sheath
artifacts.description: This magical sheath is said to keep any blade from losing its sharpness.

artifacts.name: Ranon's Memorandum
artifacts.description: A memorandum that contains all the records of magic researched by Ranon, the Mage. However, a spell is cast to show different content every time it's opened, so one must disable the spell to read the real content.

artifacts.name: Atma's Portal
artifacts.description: By going through that door, you can turn back time. It may be for a brief moment, but it's enough to gain momentum in a fight.

artifacts.name: Alsacian Spear
artifacts.description: It is said that this spear contains the souls of the spirits who protect the forest, and grants strong protection to those who wield it.

artifacts.name: Labyrinth Cube
artifacts.description: A strange relic that was found in the mysterious maze of Farche Frontier. With mysterious light emitting from it, it has the power to distort space with impact.

artifacts.name: Cursed Compass
artifacts.description: "Careful, it's a monster. Who knows what could happen if we go in the direction the compass is pointing."\n- Adventurer Laurelai

artifacts.name: Sword of the Morning
artifacts.description: "Only those with the power to control their inner energy can wield this sword."\n- Master Swordsman Rhynos

artifacts.name: Mighty Yaksha
artifacts.description: If you really want to be strong, risk your life and challenge me.

artifacts.name: Devil's Brand
artifacts.description: "As long as this brand is with you, the Devil will continue to protect you."\n- Cult Enforcer Ebarak

artifacts.name: Goblin's Lamp
artifacts.description: If you allow yourself to be seduced by the faint light floating upon the lake, the demon in the water will reach out for you.

artifacts.name: Aqua Rose
artifacts.description: This rose of eternal beauty grants great magical power to the possessor.

artifacts.name: Axe of Heavenly Mandate
artifacts.description: The swing of his axe was unstoppable; his enemies becoming an ever-growing pile of corpses.\nWritten by Reingar Media Club [Special Edition: Testimony of Ancient Weapons 6, 44p]

artifacts.name: Exorcist's Tonfa
artifacts.description: A powerful tonfa capable of smashing bones and splitting flesh. They say that when the wielders of this weapon die, their souls are bound to it.

artifacts.name: Daydream Joker
artifacts.description: Did you enjoy the world I showed you? Was it satisfying? Now, pay the price with your life.

artifacts.name: Butterfly Mandolin
artifacts.description: A mandolin used by Ludo, a pure-voiced minstrel. If you play it, you can see an illusion of butterflies made of light dancing.

artifacts.name: Envoy's Pipe
artifacts.description: Look carefully at the smoke that rises from the pipe—you'll see within whether you're destined for paradise or hell.

artifacts.name: Timeless Anchor
artifacts.description: "They say that the ship held down with that anchor is able to endure all strong winds."\n- Written by Louis [The Adventures of Louis Van Vrista, Pg. 51]

artifacts.name: Forest Totem
artifacts.description: A totem deep within the forest. Make a wish before it, and if you hear the clear ringing of a bell, your wish will come true.

artifacts.name: Oath Key
artifacts.description: "A key made in honor of the heroes who defeated the ancient monster, Nankuda, engraved with their oath to protect the world."\n- Philosopher Izet

artifacts.name: Ruby Essence
artifacts.description: Through these crimson fruits, I will gain eternal youth.

artifacts.name: Card of Small Miracles
artifacts.description: A New Year's card with a picture of Arky pulling a sled over a starry sky, on his way to grant the wishes of the people of Ritania. No matter how much time has passed, this card will help you remember your precious memories of that day.

artifacts.name: Love Potion
artifacts.description: It is said to be a magic potion of love, but in reality it is a potion that makes people honest about their innermost feelings.

artifacts.name: Portrait of the Saviors
artifacts.description: A portrait featuring the faces of the heroes who vanished after saving Orbis, drawn from Ras's memory by a famous Ezeran artist.

artifacts.name: Rainbow Scale
artifacts.description: According to legend, a handful of Merpeople have rainbow-colored scales, which possess very powerful healing properties, capable even of bringing back the dead.

artifacts.name: One Year of Gratitude
artifacts.description: Orbis has completed one long orbit around Ilryos. To convey their feelings of gratitude to Heirs for protecting Orbis all that time, Ras brings a gift, wrapped by Arky, and a letter, written by Mercedes.

artifacts.name: Midnight Bloom
artifacts.description: A type of firework used at the Full Moon Festival Afterparty. Its blooms vary from huge explosions that illuminate the entire night sky to small bursts shaped like delightful plants and animals.

artifacts.name: Spooky Solayu Stories
artifacts.description: A book written by a ghost story aficionado. The first story features a sad little ghost girl who appears within a hazy beam of light.

artifacts.name: Blessings of Camaraderie
artifacts.description: A postcard depicting a wonderful scene that could have existed at any time, on any world, in any dimension. It contains the power of gratitude and belongs to those Heirs who are about to turn the first page of an epic history.

artifacts.name: Resolute Soldier Series
artifacts.description: A series of paintings comprising the final work of the master Triviano, portraying various scenes of the Archdemon War in the utmost detail. Designated as National Treasure No. 28 of Ezera.

artifacts.name: New Year Cookies
artifacts.description: Arky heard that at the end of the year if you wear a red hat with white fur, you should give out presents to make people happy! Since Arky's such a generous Guardian, I will give Master a cookie! Just for today!

artifacts.name: Golden Cocoa Cookie
artifacts.description: A dessert made for the festival by a famous chef using special golden cocoa beans that can only be found in the forests near Perland. It is famous for its sweet flavor compared to normal cocoa.

artifacts.name: A Song for Everybody
artifacts.description: A song written by Tamarinne, dedicated to those who courageously fought to keep Orbis safe. Karin was in charge of the chorus and choreography, and Arky joins Tamarinne to perform the song as a duet.

artifacts.name: Super Duper Water Gun Shooter
artifacts.description: Achates bought a cute new water gun to use at the resort. After seeing Achates's unexpectedly impressive shooting skills and the water gun's spray power, Yufine gave her this nickname. Yufine can tell that she secretly likes it!

artifacts.name: To a New World
artifacts.description: Ras and the Heirs have been invited to a banquet in celebration of Ezeran Foundation Day. As they leave the hardships they suffered behind them, they raise their glasses in anticipation of a new, peaceful world.

artifacts.name: Moonlight's Vestige
artifacts.description: Magical ore that the Emporium specially refines and distributes every year for the Moonlight Reception. People pray for peace in the next year as they gaze at the moonlight stored inside the ore.

artifacts.name: Bloodstone
artifacts.description: As I took a bite of the fruit, a red liquid dampened my neck and chest. Instead of the copper smell of blood, the sweet scent of fruit emanated from it.

artifacts.name: XIII. Death
artifacts.description: A boy with a scythe crossed the threshold of life and death a number of times, and with each crisis he faced, he was reborn with a stronger desire to live. His red scythe symbolizes endings transforming into new beginnings and old blood transforming into new strength.

artifacts.name: XVI. The Tower
artifacts.description: After suffering the pain of deceit and betrayal, the pillars of her heart collapsed, and as she escaped the prison of passion, she embraced the freedom of destruction. However, her greed is building a new tower that will imprison her once more.

artifacts.name: XVIII. The Moon
artifacts.description: A girl with a large marble creates nightmares as she dances in the moonlight. These malicious illusions that blur the lines of purity and evil are actually a desperate attempt to bury the scars hidden deep within her subconscious. The whole world may know, but you might not.

artifacts.name: Days of Destiny
artifacts.description: In this infinite universe, this neverending chain of connections, we were destined to be together! No matter what stands in our way, we will be the ray of hope protecting this world! Right?

artifacts.name: The Guardian Star's Blessing
artifacts.description: The most highly valued relic in a city that worships stars. This relic is considered to be blessed by the Guardian Star, and every year, the high priestess uses it during a special event to offer a prayer of gratitude to the Guardian Star.

artifacts.name: XIV. Temperance
artifacts.description: With a stack of papers clutched to her chest, the girl buries the truth in a pile of valuable records that no one pays attention to. She silently endures as she limits her own potential.

artifacts.name: Official Levulin Beach Volleyball
artifacts.description: It may look like a regular beach volleyball, but after Cermia and Alexa used this volleyball in a match, its value has increased. Because it’s highly unlikely that these two will continue to play volleyball, the value of this ball keeps increasing.

artifacts.name: Records of Unity
artifacts.description: The citylords gathered in Aakhen to celebrate Cidonia's peace and harmony, with the hope that no one else will have to suffer from the hardships of war ever again.

artifacts.name: Blazing Full Moon Trophy
artifacts.description: A trophy provided by the Meldrec to celebrate the Full Moon Harvest Festival. Given to the winner of the contest who has eliminated the most monsters.

artifacts.name: Brilliant Confidence
artifacts.description: I believe that no matter the hardships you may face, or how far apart we may be, your light will never fade. No matter what happens, you’ll be able to get through it!

artifacts.name: Nostalgic Music Box
artifacts.description: A hologram music box emitting mysterious light. It reminds you of old memories since it shows whatever you desire, but it often ends up leaving you with a longing heart.

artifacts.name: III. The Empress
artifacts.description: She wears a crown made of twinkling stars and has eyes that shine with intelligence. For her, there will always be only one truth and answer, even if he does not exist by her side.

artifacts.name: IV. The Emperor
artifacts.description: He wears the sun's radiance atop his head and receives the admiration of his people. For him, the sole reason for his dedication and the only weakness in his life will always be there with him, even if she does not exist by his side.

artifacts.name: XIX. The Sun
artifacts.description: What left a stronger impression than that summer's scorching sun was the trivial memory of sharing ice cream together.

artifacts.name: VII. The Chariot
artifacts.description: No fierce wind or wave can stop her. Breaking through all hardships and obstacles, that's what youth is all about!

artifacts.name: Prelude to a New Era
artifacts.description: Leaving behind the chaotic past and with peace in their time, those who have survived have joined forces together. With their own individual goals in mind, they strive to create an ideal world.

artifacts.name: VI. The Lovers
artifacts.description: The moment when these two strangers came together and held hands for the first time, they both thought the same thing. Would they be able to hold on no matter the hardships ahead?

artifacts.name: Cutie Pando
artifacts.description: There's nobody whose heart wouldn't be stolen by an adorable baby panda. Except, that is, for a certain blue mascot who might feel their position is under attack...

artifacts.name: Our Beautiful Seasons
artifacts.description: Following a season of icy darkness, a season of resplendent light—the light of hope—finally arrives. Warm smiles abound as testament to this joyous moment, achieved only because everyone was there to support each other. "Though our journey may bring changes to our lives just like how the seasons pass, the miracle we created together shall never fade."

artifacts.name: New Year's Festival Souvenir
artifacts.description: Dolls that can be seen everywhere, and snacks that are easily found. The reason such common items feel precious is probably because they hold special memories.

artifacts.name: XVII. The Star
artifacts.description: She will continue to dream until her little wish reaches the stars, for the day she gets to perform on a grander stage with her mentor...

artifacts.name: Midnight Pizza Delivery
artifacts.description: "You little thief! You can't just eat the customer's pizza! Agh... People are going to think it was me!"

artifacts.name: Special Strawberry Cake
artifacts.description: Hey... I feel like every day we spend together is a gift. All my hardships seem to fade away when I'm with you. Th-This is a strawberry cake I made! I'm not sure if it'll taste good...but I made it just for you. I promise there's nothing weird inside...! Would you...please accept it?

artifacts.name: XV. The Devil
artifacts.description: Word of advice: think twice before reaching for a convenience store item the girl has been staring at, or you might unleash her inner devil.

artifacts.name: XII. The Hanged Man
artifacts.description: Hwayoung steels herself to break free from the shackles that once held her back. As if fate preordained it, she’s now back on the path of the Sura. The hot summer sun and the rolling waves of the ocean will guide her.

artifacts.name: Reingar Festival Dumpling
artifacts.description: A traditional Earth dish recreated by the Science Recreation Club at Yuna’s request. It’s surprisingly addictive. “I did my best with the ingredients available here...but do people on Earth really eat something like this?”

artifacts.name: Proof of Valor
artifacts.description: "Though courage and daring may not be visible to mortal eyes, this insignia will act as proof of yours. From now on, everyone you meet shall know of your valor."

artifacts.name: Victorious Flag
artifacts.description: "A flag symbolizes the authority and honor of its unit. Therefore, it is bestowed upon the most trustworthy person. I present to you this flag, with faith that you will be the beacon of hope on our path to victory."

artifacts.name: Cruel Mischief
artifacts.description: Once upon a time, a girl's parents asked a mage to transform their tomboyish daughter into an elegant lady. He fulfilled their request, and the parents were thrilled to see how obedient she had become, not realizing she had been replaced by a doll.

artifacts.name: A Symbol of Unity
artifacts.description: "The valor of one is not enough to earn victory for all—you must make colleagues you can trust and rely on. It is only once you are connected by your determination and have become one another's swords and shields that victory will be yours."

artifacts.name: War Horn
artifacts.description: "The battlefield is full of frightened and terrified souls, but only defeat awaits those who fail to overcome their fears. Now, with the sound of this horn, transform those fears into courage."

artifacts.name: Guide to a Decision
artifacts.description: "A good commander must be aware of everything that could happen on the battlefield and make decisions accordingly. May this map help you with that difficult process so that your judgment won't be clouded by the fear of making the wrong decision."

artifacts.name: Bastion of Hope
artifacts.description: "When it becomes apparent that you're on the verge of defeat, soldiers will often become frustrated and surrender. When that time comes, take hold of this shield and save your soldiers. This shield will be a symbol that reinvigorates your troops, encouraging those who are in despair to continue to move forward toward victory."

artifacts.name: P.O.S
artifacts.description: A passage connected to the REAL WORLD, FLAT, and KWANGYA. Only nævis—the Gate Manager—can open it.

artifacts.name: Frantic Flight
artifacts.description: “No, no! This is mine, keep your hands off!”\nOut of breath, Witch Skinneri frantically poured magic into her broom, narrowly dodging the grasp of the Phantom Wind and escaping by a hair.

artifacts.name: Unleashed Axe of Heavenly Mandate
artifacts.description: An ancient relic with mysteriously unleashed power. It is to be bestowed upon the final champion of the Orbis Gladiatorium. It gleams with the brilliance of past glory.

artifacts.name: Tagehel's Ancient Book
artifacts.description: A book written in the characters of the fallen Kingdom of Tagehel. Researchers are working hard to discover the meaning and principles behind the characters and unlock the mysterious power they hold.

artifacts.name: Sashe Ithanes
artifacts.description: This is the Sashe Ithanes. It is a flame that will shake the world on its axis, that will destroy people, cities, kingdoms, even dreams. Take it, and in my name bring an end to everything.

artifacts.name: Sigurd Scythe
artifacts.description: As the moonlight revealed a figure holding a scythe, the astonished onlookers exclaimed "the God of Death has descended!"

artifacts.name: Rod of Amaryllis
artifacts.description: Everyone who fights for the salvation of the world will have the divine protection of the Goddess.

artifacts.name: Sword of Holy Light
artifacts.description: The soft light emitted by the sword shields its owner from all injuries.

artifacts.name: Bottle of Knowledge
artifacts.description: A glass jar that is sealed to safely preserve Powder of Knowledge. As an alchemy material, it is used to bring out the potential of other mystical items.\n\nWhen used as an Enhancement Ingredient, it can Limit Break a 5★ Artifact, excluding certain Artifacts.

artifacts.name: Sigurd Scythe
artifacts.description: As the moonlight revealed a figure holding a scythe, the astonished onlookers exclaimed "the God of Death has descended!"

artifacts.name: Durandal
artifacts.description: The soft light emitted by the sword shields its owner from all injuries.

artifacts.name: El's Fist
artifacts.description: "While holding this gauntlet, you can destroy anything you touch, as if it had never even existed!"\n- Guard Maid, El

artifacts.name: Hell Cutter
artifacts.description: "Look at this saw... isn't it awesome?"\n- Notorious Lunatic, Ralakia

artifacts.name: Strak Gauntlet
artifacts.description: "When the eclipse began, those small gloves started to spew fire and engulf my whole body. The spirit inside the gloves had woken up, and we were able to defeat the Archdemon."\n- Heir Aki

artifacts.name: Uberius's Tooth
artifacts.description: Treasure of the Wintenberg royal family made from the remains of wicked dragon Uberius. It's said to be capable of ripping dragon scale armor.

artifacts.name: Border Coin
artifacts.description: "Heads, I'll pretend I didn't see anything and let you go free. But tails..."\nCountless people have had their fortunes rely on this old gold coin.

artifacts.name: Junkyard Dog
artifacts.description: A weapon created to embody the ability of the Outrage. It is a combination of the Fireseal and the Flashing Tooth, which is one of the Sacred Treasures, originally possessed by the Conclave on Sol's home planet.

artifacts.name: Creation & Destruction
artifacts.description: A scissor-like weapon that can be used as two separate swords, forged by the greatest blacksmith at Lilibet's request. In mockery of the official religion of Rekos, the blades are named after Cho and Mal, the demons of creation and destruction.

artifacts.name: Crimson Seed
artifacts.description: A token in the shape of the small flame emblem of Meldrec, used as proof of friendly relations and to show that an outsider has been granted passage through Meldrec by the great chief.

artifacts.name: Draco Plate
artifacts.description: "Isn't it ironic? That Dragon's skin and bones are now used to make armor to protect the very Dragon Knights of Wintenberg it cursed as it died."\nThe queen laughed as she wiped the blood from her armor.

artifacts.name: Sepulcrum
artifacts.description: "All those who wander shall embrace death under my blade. My sword will be the gravestone of sinners."\n- Mary the Benevolent Punisher

artifacts.name: Alencinox's Wrath
artifacts.description: The most vulnerable point on a Dragon's body is protected by their toughest scales. An accurate shot can kill a Dragon in an instant, but if you miss, their wrath will ensure you do not live long enough to regret it.

artifacts.name: Merciless Glutton
artifacts.description: This blade's name is derived from the brutal scar it leaves behind, which makes it appear as though the victim's skin was torn by the bite of a giant beast. In order to effectively control the blade, a strength that goes beyond the realm of Humans is needed.

artifacts.name: Flower Shower
artifacts.description: The perfect magical tool for a girl who loves attention. Her sudden appearance in a shower of petals and a flash of light is like a dream, though for many it is more akin to a scene from a nightmare.

artifacts.name: Cradle of Life
artifacts.description: "They say Humans do not require meaning to exist; therefore, they are capable of becoming free. Does that mean a being born with a specific purpose can never truly be free?"

artifacts.name: Circus Fantasia
artifacts.description: "I've mastered all kinds of acrobatics, so there's no performance beyond my abilities. Curious, aren't you? I'll invite you to see it for yourself!"

artifacts.name: Champion's Trophy
artifacts.description: A glorious trophy given to the winner of the 7th Beach Volleyball Championship. The prize also included fifty meal coupons for use at the summer festival.

artifacts.name: Snow Crystal
artifacts.description: The specialty of Pathfinder Village, made of compressed ice that is kept from melting with a magic spell. Due to the mysterious, beautiful light they give off, they're often used to make lamps or other decorations.

artifacts.name: Samsara Prayer Beads
artifacts.description: "With this...will I grow stronger?"\nOld prayer beads of unknown origin passed down since long ago. It is said that depending on the nature of the wearer, it can grant partial control of natural power.

artifacts.name: A Little Queen's Huge Crown
artifacts.description: An enormous crown that Chloe carries with her for the moment when she becomes a true queen. She aspires to become a queen whose power is as impressive and glamorous as the crown itself. As for where and how she found it... That's Chloe's secret!

artifacts.name: Azure Comet
artifacts.description: It's a very heavy iron ball on a chain, but Rem wields it as though it were light as a feather.

artifacts.name: Anti-Magic Mask
artifacts.description: A mask Rimuru received from Shizu. Shizu asked Rimuru to absorb her, and Rimuru inherited Shizu's appearance, mask, and memories.

artifacts.name: Pure White Trust
artifacts.description: A sword and costume that the Shadow Elves had presented to Humans in the distant past as a token of their trust while interacting with them. They contain the Spirits' blessing as well as the Shadow Elves' magic. Having been passed from owner to owner, it has now fallen into Zahhak's possession after the collapse of the Human kingdom.

artifacts.name: Jack-O's Symbol
artifacts.description: A mask that controls her emotional changes and an iron ball that she uses when fighting. Both are always carried by Jack-O' and resemble jack-o'-lanterns.

artifacts.name: Indestructible Gaiters
artifacts.description: Gaiters worn by Hwayoung ever since she became a martial artist. It is an object that is said to have been crafted by combining the techniques of several ancient races. Despite being used for a long time, it is so tough that it remains without a scratch.

artifacts.name: Spear of Purification
artifacts.description: A spear made with the body and energy of a Great Wicked that was defeated after countless sacrifices were made during a great war in the distant past. It is known to unleash one's physical limit to their extremities, but most wielders faced tragic ends when they could not handle the potential of the spear.

artifacts.name: Fullmetal's Automail
artifacts.description: The artificial arm and leg that Winry created for Edward. Though it sometimes gets destroyed during battles, it becomes more durable every time it gets fixed. Winry takes great pride in it.

artifacts.name: Sword of Autumn Eclipse
artifacts.description: The Autumn Sword has been passed down through the Suin of the Prairie for a long time. It is said that the sword can only be lifted by those that the sword has acknowledged. The sword imbues its bearer and those around them with unwavering courage and hope.

artifacts.name: Benimaru's Tachi
artifacts.description: A tachi wielded by the Commander-in-Chief, Benimaru. Created by the blacksmith Kurobe, it is a near-perfect weapon that can withstand Benimaru's flames.

artifacts.name: Golden Rose
artifacts.description: A rose made of gold in remembrance of the past glory and splendor of the Bloodrose family. It symbolizes unwithering beauty and passion.

artifacts.name: Prayer of Solitude
artifacts.description: She looks up at the night sky, shrouded in its pitch-black robe of darkness, and sees a lone star, shining brightly. She wishes upon the star with a desperate heart, asking it to stay by her side.

artifacts.name: Tyrant's Descent
artifacts.description: A notorious family treasure of the Drake family, infamous for ending battles in bloodshed and terror. It had been missing for a long time until the most recent successor emerged and started a war.

artifacts.name: Pipette Lance
artifacts.description: A Divine-class lance, which serves as Shalltear's main weapon. Resembling a giant spuit covered in metal adornments, it has the powerful ability to recover the wielder's health proportional to damage dealt.

artifacts.name: Sweet Miracle
artifacts.description: Being able to sing on stage feels like a miracle to me. Would you like to be a part of our sweet miracle?

artifacts.name: Ruyi Jingu Bang
artifacts.description: A tool used to measure the depth of rivers and seas. No one would dream of using it as a weapon because of its sheer weight, except Wukong, the only one who can wield it at will.

artifacts.name: Thorn of the Blue Rose
artifacts.description: A mystic blade once kept in the Hilag family’s secret vault, deemed too dangerous for anyone to wield. While it consumes immense mana from its wielder, it grants devastating strength in return. After using this sword, Krau always takes advantage of its side effects as an excuse to request paid leave.

artifacts.name: Strike of Aspiration
artifacts.description: Driven by her enduring desire to sever all evil from the world, Star Fencer Ayla channels her remaining energy into one final strike.

artifacts.name: Jumbo Berry Special
artifacts.description: The jumbo berry special that he could hardly finish as a kid and had to split with his master.

artifacts.name: Ritual of Sealing Flames
artifacts.description: After each battle, the moment Aki rewraps the bandages to subdue the raging flames feels like a painful ritual—one that brings back memories of someone long lost.

artifacts.name: Tome of Life's End
artifacts.description: A forbidden tome that can only be read by the inheritor of Sigurd Scythe, the royal heirloom. It contains the lifespans of all Humans born and raised in Tartarus.\n\n"O guide of the most noble goddess, I beseech you—lead my soul into the eternal cycle."

artifacts.name: Holy Sacrifice
artifacts.description: The Statue of Grace is given to whichever knight wins the Goddess's favor and will save them from death once before shattering to pieces.\nWritten by Barrett [Treasures of the Sacred Kingdom, 15p]

artifacts.name: Elbris Ritual Sword
artifacts.description: A ceremonial sword handed down by the Elves for thousands of years, the blade is infused with several springs of magic. The person who owns this sword becomes the king of Elves.

artifacts.name: Aurius
artifacts.description: Legendary hero Knight Commander Rowell's tower shield.

artifacts.name: Adamant Shield
artifacts.description: "That damn shield can't be penetrated by anything. I guarantee you, cause even my sword couldn't."\n- Star Fencer Ayla

artifacts.name: Hilag Lance
artifacts.description: As she lifted her lance, a cry burst out from behind her. She believed she would soon be able to overthrow the Archdemon.\n"If I cannot do it, Goddess, give me the power to fight on forever."

artifacts.name: Noble Oath
artifacts.description: An emblem given to members of Ezera's Orders after they pledge to dedicate their lives to the Goddess. Those given to knights resemble an escutcheon, while those given to priests resemble a rosary.

artifacts.name: Justice for All
artifacts.description: A gauntlet made the year the first member of the Sharon family was knighted. It represents the pursuit of justice to be shared by all who follow the Goddess and the kingdom, rather than just for the sake of oneself.

artifacts.name: Sword of Ezera
artifacts.description: "Because the color and shape is different to the holy sword wielded by the real life Ezeran legend..."\nThe final part of the etching on the sword's hilt has been lost to time, but a mysterious force can still be felt flowing through the blade.

artifacts.name: Bastion of Perlutia
artifacts.description: A divine weapon passed down in the Perlutia family that may only be wielded by those born to be leaders. It chooses its master of its own will and rearranges its dark, hexagonal pieces to take the form most optimal for any situation. It was locked away for decades with no one to wield it, but finally, it has found a new master to bring it back into the world.

artifacts.name: Steadfast Gatekeeper
artifacts.description: "This sword was forged not to take lives but to keep those within our castle safe. Never forget that our utmost duty is to prevent even a single drop of blood from being shed inside these walls."

artifacts.name: Rise of a Monarch
artifacts.description: "I will not forget—I wield my spear and bear the burden of the crown, all for the sake of my people."\nOn that day, the heaviest weight in the world fell upon the shoulders of the bravest soul in Wintenberg.

artifacts.name: Crown of Glory
artifacts.description: In the national swordsmanship tournament held to appoint an elite knight to protect the first in line to the throne of Lefundos, the winner, crowned with a laurel wreath, was neither the son of a noble family nor a veteran knight but an ordinary young man, not even twenty years of age.

artifacts.name: Ancient Dragon's Legacy
artifacts.description: A magical tool that can be used to move to a golden chamber filled with rare goods and weaponry that lie sleeping. Once unlocked, the tool allows one to access the passage to the treasure chamber from anywhere.

artifacts.name: Spear of a New Dawn
artifacts.description: This spear is said to have been used by a knight who reclaimed the throne and established a new kingdom. Legends say that whoever takes hold of this spear can begin a new era, and as a result, many covet the spear, but its whereabouts are currently unknown. However, there have been reports recently that a knight with silver hair wields a similar-looking spear.

artifacts.name: Wings of Light and Shadow
artifacts.description: A spear forged with rage and sorrow and tempered with resentment. Under a flash of white light, everything collapsed; under a looming dark shadow, nothing could escape.

artifacts.name: Sphere of Sadism
artifacts.description: A metallic sphere that is connected to Yulha's consciousness. It can freely change form and density at her discretion. While it is most often used as a form of defense, it can also be used as a form of offense. Due to its resiliency, the sphere can quickly regenerate even after being destroyed.

artifacts.name: Mature Sunglasses
artifacts.description: A pair of sunglasses Charlotte bought in an attempt to look mature. No one has to know that she has put them on and taken them off in front of a mirror dozens of times.

artifacts.name: Rocket Punch Gauntlet
artifacts.description: ae-KARINA's main weapon. Just like its name, Rocket Punch is a powerful gauntlet that can destroy enemies in a single strike.

artifacts.name: Broken Will of the Priest
artifacts.description: A token that once belonged to a high priest. It symbolizes a faithful heart towards Noias. Though the token is broken, his faith will be dutifully handed down to remaining successors.

artifacts.name: 3F
artifacts.description: Albedo's main weapon, a giant bardiche. Wielding 3F, she punishes those who have been disrespectful to Ainz without hesitation.

artifacts.name: M.O.A.S
artifacts.description: Though originally designed to nullify magical attack damage, this device gained an auto-targeting feature at the whim of a developer.\n"The best defense is a strong offense... Ah, Earth's proverbs really do inspire romantic ideals! Don't you agree?"

artifacts.name: A Precious Connection
artifacts.description: We could have passed each other by as strangers, yet you became a precious connection that I now treasure. I am always grateful that our paths crossed, and I will cherish what we share — always.

artifacts.name: Glorious Throne
artifacts.description: A throne containing the might of the Star Devourer. Though its former master relinquished that power and departed, the throne still silently awaits the arrival of the next monarch.

artifacts.name: With a Little Friend
artifacts.description: A small bird encountered by chance on the journey back home. The sky is clear, and footsteps are light. With a friend to accompany her, she is no longer lonely.

artifacts.name: Rhianna & Luciella
artifacts.description: "You're today's target."\n"I'll let you know now that there's nowhere to run."\n- Moon Assassins, Rhianna and Luciella

artifacts.name: Wind Rider
artifacts.description: Famously known as the Phantom Wind, Rinak would sneak into the mansions of the rich with ghost-like stealth and vanish with their most expensive possessions.

artifacts.name: Moonlight Dreamblade
artifacts.description: "Whether you take the path before you or not, it's all your choice to make."\nThe White Shining Blade's voice whispered in my mind.

artifacts.name: Elyha's Knife
artifacts.description: Whenever Elyha, the leader of the Black Fog Company, wielded a knife, it got darker with blood and more brutal every time.

artifacts.name: Dust Devil
artifacts.description: "Once this long fight is over, will everything go back to the way it was?"\nNoha, who is later praised as the Hero of the Dejurak Desert, mused with a deep sigh.

artifacts.name: Santa Muerte
artifacts.description: There was nothing that Haste's scythe could not slay. The peaceful darkness could not stand in its way, nor even could life and death, until eventually he slayed even his own humanity.

artifacts.name: Alexa's Basket
artifacts.description: A basket Alexa carries whenever she goes on a picnic with someone she wishes to become close to, containing everything necessary for a nice lunch in a beautiful forest. Just taking it along will elicit the joy of a pleasant picnic outing.

artifacts.name: Violet Talisman
artifacts.description: "As long as you believe in victory, the light of hope shall never fade. Remember that, my son. Our family's legacy now rests on your shoulders."\n- Violet's Father

artifacts.name: Torn Sleeve
artifacts.description: A torn sleeve out of which various weapons appear as though they are prosthetic limbs. She never has explained how she manages to fit so many things up there.

artifacts.name: Shepherds of Chaos
artifacts.description: New kinds of Unknown that came to Orbis through Chaos Gates. Their appearance and traits differ from that of the Unknown that previously appeared in Ritania. Most are acting under someone's command, and a few appear to possess some intelligence.

artifacts.name: Silver Rain
artifacts.description: After her shurikens poured down from the sky, the alley was awash with blood.

artifacts.name: Alabastron
artifacts.description: A bottle that contains a mystical fragrant oil infused with the power of Lunaris. It is said that if you perform a purifying ceremony with this, you will be granted life as a sacred being.

artifacts.name: Manica of Control
artifacts.description: Sez's arm was modified and weaponized as part of an experiment in the past. After he escaped the facility, it grew more and more powerful until he could no longer control it. Sez considered this power a curse and used clothes and gloves to conceal his arm. After coming to realize this, the members of the Phantom CIC made him a special glove to help him control its power.

artifacts.name: Secret Art - Storm Sword
artifacts.description: A book passed down through generations of Celine's family. It contains the secret to a form of sword art that allows one to channel the energy within their body to strike down their foes with lightning speed.

artifacts.name: Shepherd of the Hollow
artifacts.description: "To those fools who cannot be redeemed: kneel down, despair, and obey."\nThose who fell to his sword soon lost themselves and rose up as Dust Walkers.

artifacts.name: Double-Edged Decrescent
artifacts.description: "Were the trusty sword on your shoulder to slip even slightly, it could slit your throat. The same is true of people—the closer you keep them, the more easily they're able to harm you."

artifacts.name: Sword of Summer Twilight
artifacts.description: A sword given to Vildred by the eastern swordsman who taught him swordsmanship. It glows faintly when moonlight strikes its surface. It is known as the Summer Sword, one of the four swords crafted long, long ago.

artifacts.name: Sword of Winter Shadow
artifacts.description: One of the Four Seasons Swords that was made in the distant past. Unlike other swords, the Winter Sword's innate power flows on its surface without restraint. It is said that those who are not chosen by the sword will find themselves frozen by its power if they try to wield it.

artifacts.name: Goblet of Oath
artifacts.description: An object handed down in Peira's exterminated tribe. It contains the power of the previous chiefs, and is said to grant those who are able to complete the ceremony their power and spirit. However, with most individuals losing their sanity before completing the ceremony, there have been very few to actually take on the challenge.

artifacts.name: Sword of Cycling Seasons
artifacts.description: The sword that contains the harmonized power of the Spirit Lords that reside within each of the Four Seasons Swords. The only person that can wield this blade to its truest potential is Adin, Silvana's successor and Savior of Natalon.

artifacts.name: The Armament
artifacts.description: ae-WINTER's main weapon. The Armament, like its name, can transform into any type of weapon, allowing its owner to fight at her best even in the worst scenarios.

artifacts.name: Hostess of the Banquet
artifacts.description: Following the waves of agony that descended upon the depraved underground, a new hostess emerges to claim her rightful place.

artifacts.name: Seductive Flower
artifacts.description: "After you've been chewed and digested... We're going to merge into one and be reborn anew." Enticing her prey, her voice sounds sweeter than honey.

artifacts.name: Beguiling Wings
artifacts.description: "In my presence, there's nothing you can do." In the pitch-black night, nothing remained except the echo of her wings flapping.

artifacts.name: Dark Blood Keeper
artifacts.description: An ancestral sword of the Lenox family, crafted for those who keep their oaths. As a gift of gratitude and admiration, Conwell gifted it to Jenua Roland, who lost one of his legs while guarding Conwell.

artifacts.name: Feed of Criticism
artifacts.description: Buried under mounting misunderstandings, Tori withdraws from the world. Alone in her darkened room, she silently hopes her true feelings will somehow reach others.

artifacts.name: Discreet Hands
artifacts.description: Swift as the wind, Rinak picks her clients' pockets to gather criminal funds. Little does she know that her actions are being observed...

artifacts.name: Summer Photogenic
artifacts.description: Today’s photographer is the curious cat! A picture-perfect moment sealed with the final touch of the cat’s toe bean print, as summer memories are captured in the frame, one by one.

artifacts.name: Lethal Whispers
artifacts.description: Even the most steadfast bodyguard falters before the lady’s dangerous whispers. The bodyguard has no doubt in her mind that this is all because of the demon’s influence.

artifacts.name: Master of the Nightmare
artifacts.description: To Sharun, who binds herself in guilt, the Wicked, taking the form of Zio, sows nightmares. Step by step, a hungry shadow slowly approaches its prey.

artifacts.name: Glorious Flag
artifacts.description: “First to the finish line—Sigret! Truly, this is the age of Sigret!”\nWith breathtaking speed and brilliant riding skill, Sigret rose to fame overnight. After defeating her formidable rivals in her very first race, the flag she waved at the finish line became a legend among racing fans.

artifacts.name: Shadow Winds 7
artifacts.description: A gunblade specially crafted for Tactical Archetype Coli who excels in urban combat. Combining a firearm with blades, it can be used effectively at both close and long range.

artifacts.name: Butterfly's Baptism
artifacts.description: Through a blood-stained baptism, two butterflies drifting over scattered dreams are connected as one. "The two of us are one that can never be separated, Luciella."

artifacts.name: Bloodstone
artifacts.description: As I took a bite of the fruit, a red liquid spilled out. Instead of the copper smell of blood, the sweet scent of fruit emanated from it.

artifacts.name: Song of Stars
artifacts.description: As the strings start to vibrate, the starlight illuminates her.

artifacts.name: Infinity Basket
artifacts.description: Now, put your most expensive possession in this basket - it doubles! Put in two? Quadruples! This isn't a scam, trust me!

artifacts.name: Sashe Ithanes
artifacts.description: This is the Sashe Ithanes. It is a flame that will shake the world on its axis, that will destroy people, cities, kingdoms, even dreams. Take it, and in my name bring an end to everything.

artifacts.name: Rosa Hargana
artifacts.description: Gun mage Amber Rose was an expert in lightweight magic and sharpshooting. Her magic bullets never missed, even when aimed at her own lover.

artifacts.name: Otherworldly Machinery
artifacts.description: For the people of Orbis, Yuna's cellphone is a peculiar item that they couldn't understand.

artifacts.name: Ambrote
artifacts.description: After a final prayer, she took her bow made from the branches of the World Tree and leaped onto the battlefield full of death, wishing to restore the world in the belief that all things will be born anew.

artifacts.name: Iron Fan
artifacts.description: "Ladies use fans for many purposes: hiding smiles, expressing feelings indirectly, and of course, eliminating enemies."

artifacts.name: Sword of Judgment
artifacts.description: "If you truly are innocent, then the Goddess will save you from my sword."\nWhether it is blood or the dark red of rose petals that falls in that next moment, it is unclear.

artifacts.name: Reingar's Special Drink
artifacts.description: A drink specially made in Reingar. With its pretty color and sweet scent, this drink is great for relaxation. They say this drink also enhances concentration, memorization, and judgment, but this hasn't been verified yet.

artifacts.name: Andre's Crossbow
artifacts.description: "This crossbow has been modified to my own personal specifications. As long as I'm using this, there's no target I cannot hit."

artifacts.name: Dux Noctis
artifacts.description: "According to my mother, this necklace holds a wolf's power. That's why it shines brighter on nights you can see the moon clearly. It means the wolf will soon begin its relentless chase."

artifacts.name: Guiding Light
artifacts.description: The bright star shining within the dark crystal resembles the North Star, and is determined to guide people through chaotic times.

artifacts.name: Ms. Confille
artifacts.description: A long-range rifle owned by Elphelt Valentine. It is a special weapon that allows the bearer to change magic into bullets, and thus it allows any ordinary person to use powerful attacks.

artifacts.name: Wall of Order
artifacts.description: A device that can restrict access to certain districts under the authority of the police. Unless granted access from the authorities, no one can enter.

artifacts.name: Unseen Observer
artifacts.description: A mobile data device created just for Flan. It supports hologram displays and allows Flan to access Politia's information network anytime, anywhere.

artifacts.name: Air-to-Surface Missile: MISHA
artifacts.description: Kanna's favorite missile. She holds it in her arms every night before she switches off to sleep mode, dreaming of the day she can finally use it.

artifacts.name: Star of the Deep Sea
artifacts.description: A gem of profound and mysterious sheen, sometimes found in seashells. It is said that these are pieces of a star that fell off as it was shaking water off its body after freshening up at sea.

artifacts.name: Glo-Wings 21
artifacts.description: It is named after its shape which looks like wings floating around the bearer. However, instead of being used for flight, it is used to project energy to attack, or to create a barrier to defend.

artifacts.name: Sharpshooter's Handgun
artifacts.description: Riza's favorite handgun. Though she owns many different types, she uses this one the most. She carries it with her everywhere, whether it be for missions or even going about her daily routine.

artifacts.name: Spatiotemporal Fan
artifacts.description: A fan that creates a rift between spaces. It allows the bearer to open and close Dimensional Gates wherever they like. Within the gate is an imaginary space conjured with Lua's power, and therefore no one can escape without her permission.

artifacts.name: Seal of Capture
artifacts.description: A mysterious scroll used by a monk that fought against the demons of Natalon. Demons that caused tremendous chaos have been sealed within as drawings.

artifacts.name: Sphere of Inferno
artifacts.description: A blue flame that is connected with Beehoo's consciousness. It can freely change into a variety of shapes at his discretion and can easily pick out a target from within a crowd. However, it can't be used for a prolonged period for it burns his life force.

artifacts.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
artifacts.description: The first pistol Eligos purchased when he left Taranor's world of crime and founded the Dagger Sicar. He will only pull out this piece when there is an issue that must be resolved.

artifacts.name: Elegiac Candle
artifacts.description: After sealing away the demons, she returned to the shrine and lit a candle, hoping to bring eternal peace to the world.

artifacts.name: Old Gardening Shears
artifacts.description: "I'm too afraid to use it anymore, it looks like it'll break at any moment. Well, what can you expect from a tacky toy a kid could barely afford with her allowance money," said Byblis, as she carefully put away her shears into a drawer.

artifacts.name: Dreamlike Holiday
artifacts.description: A hair accessory Landy gave to Flan as a gift. Feeling deeply touched, Flan wore it throughout the entire vacation.

artifacts.name: Renewed Will
artifacts.description: Among the items left by his mother were books that contain all her knowledge and strong will, as well as vivid traces of her several exciting adventures. These became the bedrock for his newly found resolve.

artifacts.name: An Assassin’s Pledge
artifacts.description: “Doesn’t matter who you are or where you’ve scurried off to, I will find you. You see — your life? It’s got quite the lucrative price tag.”

artifacts.name: Awakened Leaf
artifacts.description: Witnessing the silent budding of life, Saria carved deep into her heart once more why she must protect Dun Blyraia.

artifacts.name: Gifted Pen
artifacts.description: A fountain pen bestowed by Schniel, the lord who recognized Ruiza’s worth. When it comes time to sign her name, this is the only pen she uses.

artifacts.name: Aubade Orb
artifacts.description: Some nights become the hope that leads to daybreak. For Ludwig, who is heading towards the dawn after a long darkness, there is no longer any reason to hesitate.

artifacts.name: Intoxicating Indulgence
artifacts.description: Deep in the sea, the tentacles of the Void Coral wrap around Aube's body. A sweet and sticky wave slowly consumes her body and mind.

artifacts.name: Abyssal Crown
artifacts.description: "May those ruled by the crown walk the road of corruption forever."\n- Witch Reinwood, hung high up on the stake

artifacts.name: Etica's Scepter
artifacts.description: When the empire is in its greatest peril, the exiled princess, Etica, will return with the five spirits to take back the royal hall and call down a rain of repentance to save the devastated world.

artifacts.name: Tagehel's Ancient Book
artifacts.description: A book written in the characters of the fallen Kingdom of Tagehel. Researchers are working hard to discover the meaning and principles behind the characters and unlock the mysterious power they hold.

artifacts.name: Kal'adra
artifacts.description: A cursed weapon created by the fallen priest, Sestia. It causes a mental breakdown in the target by reminding them of their most painful memories. Even ages later, when fallen priests have sided with the Covenant, use of this mask is banned.

artifacts.name: Sira-Ren
artifacts.description: This rare magical flower blooms from the corpse of a Human who possessed incredible magic power. It quickly withers away unless it is constantly being infused with powerful Mana. Few have been lucky enough to witness such a sight.

artifacts.name: Time Matter
artifacts.description: A source of power that Guardian Kazran wields that controls time. It can bring forth a time in the past that no one can remember.

artifacts.name: Chatty
artifacts.description: I was once the best mercenary in the world!! Before Serila... No, master trapped my soul inside this lantern.

artifacts.name: Iela Violin
artifacts.description: "No matter how much power or darkness one wields, they're just a part of the audience."\nIela started to play the violin and her melody touched the hearts of all that heard it. Even the genius mage who was only interested in fighting was moved.

artifacts.name: Radiant Forever
artifacts.description: A flash appears with creation; a flare passes by with death. This crystal, created by a consolidation of all light within life, is said to have immense power.

artifacts.name: Necro & Undine
artifacts.description: Two sentient wings on Dizzy's back. When attacking, the green wing becomes Necro, a grim reaper, and the blue wing becomes Undine, an angel. Though their personalities often clash, both of them consider Dizzy's safety their highest priority.

artifacts.name: Spirit's Breath
artifacts.description: "Through them... I can feel it. The pain and agony in this world..."\nIt is said that only a few Shaman of Rekos can hear the Spirits' whispers.

artifacts.name: Tear of the Desert
artifacts.description: A jewel insignia that is made of Peridot found only in the nearby desert of Savara and granted exclusively to a few credited mercenaries by Basar himself. Adventurers of the desert covet it for its mystical blue glow that grows brighter as a sandstorm approaches.

artifacts.name: Dignus Orb
artifacts.description: "Whenever times are hard, I just look up to the sky, and it shows me the way forward."

artifacts.name: Bloody Rose
artifacts.description: "I will steal that power from him and bring my family back from the dead, then he too will learn how it feels to lose everything. Just watch me."

artifacts.name: Barthez's Orbuculum
artifacts.description: There is no need to ask me about the future. Now that you are my master, everything will unfold according to your desires. The future is in your hands.

artifacts.name: Black Hand of the Goddess
artifacts.description: A glove made to maximize an enhanced mage's magic. It draws out limitless power so that one may fight against many. However, because it was made without consideration of the harmful effects it may have upon the wearer, the wearer suffers from terrible side effects.

artifacts.name: Last Teatime
artifacts.description: "You finally found what you wanted, my lady."\n"Stop imposing on me, you fool."\nOblivious to the events that would soon unfold before them, Baal smiled to himself when Sezan found the spell for the forbidden magic ceremony.

artifacts.name: Crimson Moon of Nightmares
artifacts.description: It's hard to even venture a guess as to when this red marble was created. This marble creates the illusion that an immense full moon has risen in the sky, bringing forth the deep madness hidden within any who see it and trapping them in a never-ending hallucination.

artifacts.name: Fairy Tale for a Nightmare
artifacts.description: A girl with a bouncy blue skirt dashes from place to place, just like a rabbit. Where could she be going? Perhaps the answer lies within a fairy tale.

artifacts.name: Knowledge Seed
