artifacts.description: A capsule created in preparation for the final days of Politis's home planet, Paradia. It's a cache of Paradia's heritage that includes relics of their technology, knowledge, culture, and art so that their legacy can live on even if their planet disappears.

artifacts.name: Twilight Calamity
artifacts.description: It is said that all those who looked into the brilliant twilight emitted by the staff drowned in a pool of light redder than blood.

artifacts.name: Severed Horn Wand
artifacts.description: This is the wand Ram carries with her. She wields it often when using magic.

artifacts.name: Magic for Friends
artifacts.description: A device modified from a mysterious magic accessory that was given to Ras. By adding magic equations and auxiliary equipment to the device, Mercedes can now safely wield her incredible power.

artifacts.name: Upgraded Dragon Knuckles
artifacts.description: Upgraded Dragon Knuckles are a gift from Rimuru that Milim really likes. They have an effect that reduces Milim's strength, allowing her to control her power.

artifacts.name: Scroll of Shadows
artifacts.description: A scroll to summon contracted creatures through shadow magic. The scroll became full of words as she learned more magic.

artifacts.name: Ignition Cloth Gloves
artifacts.description: Gloves that have transmutation circles drawn into the fabric. They are made from a special flammable fabric. Combined with Roy's proficiency in oxygen manipulation alchemy, the gloves allow him to ignite huge flames.

artifacts.name: Frame of Light
artifacts.description: ae-GISELLE's special frame that glows translucently. It can completely immobilize anyone who is touched by its frame.

artifacts.name: Umbral Keystones
artifacts.description: A collection of colorful gems Fumyr uses to study magic and store mana. Although her innate magical talent is wholly unaffected by her materials, it subtly embodies her personal preferences embracing the notion that prettier is always preferable.

artifacts.name: Staff of Ainz Ooal Gown
artifacts.description: Ainz's personal weapon and the symbol of Ainz Ooal Gown, crafted by his Guild members. Its power is of the same level as that of a World Item, and it's entwined by seven serpents, each adorned with a Divine-class artifact gemstone in the mouth.

artifacts.name: Magic Bubble Maker
artifacts.description: Grandpa, you told me that brighter days are just around the corner. Looking at the smiles on the faces of those around me, I believe those days have finally arrived.

artifacts.name: Mirrored Lotus Ring
artifacts.description: A ring gifted by Himmel. In flower-language, the mirrored lotus represents eternal love.

artifacts.name: Butterfly Hair Ornament
artifacts.description: A birthday gift from Frieren. It is one of Fern’s most precious belongings that she has decorating her hair at all times.

artifacts.name: Refracted Desire
artifacts.description: The special lens created by Fumyr's magic clearly reveals even the slightest irregularities on the surface of a pebble. A sly curiosity subtly lingers on her face as she seeks new knowledge.

artifacts.name: Rod of Amaryllis
artifacts.description: Everyone who fights for the salvation of the world will have the divine protection of the Goddess.

artifacts.name: Shimadra Staff
artifacts.description: "Let's end this together."\n- The Great Fallen Priest, Shimadra

artifacts.name: Water's Origin
artifacts.description: "Wherever this talisman is, I will be too. To bring safety from storms, freedom from illness, life where once there was only ruin."\n- Shaman Cizette

artifacts.name: Wondrous Potion Vial
artifacts.description: "A potion of love, or a potion of eternal youth. Only one of each exists in this world. Which do you choose?"\n- A Senior Fellow of the Alchemy Society, Pei

artifacts.name: Magaraha's Tome
artifacts.description: An ancient book written by a great mage. It contains all of Magaraha's magical research. Due to its complicated content and massive volume, even those ambitious enough to try to read it all had to give up after turning only a few pages.

artifacts.name: Celestine
artifacts.description: A rare ore extracted from near the Sanctuary. Known as the Blessing of Diche, it has the power to infuse the wearer with the energy of life and is carried by royalty and some high-ranking priests.

artifacts.name: Idol's Cheer
artifacts.description: I believe that music can change the world. Because it changed me!

artifacts.name: Eternus
artifacts.description: "An eternal promise of perpetual confinement. Through endless cycles of death and rebirth, you will be intertwined."\nAccording to myth, the cursed archmage Heindel has spent thousands of years traveling the world to find a way to free himself from the ring's domination.

artifacts.name: Stella Harpa
artifacts.description: An ancient relic of the Shandra Empire handed down between the High Priests and Priestesses of Constella. It is said that when the harp is played while singing, stars fall from the night sky and fireflies soar upward.

artifacts.name: Unfading Memories
artifacts.description: Diene always kept a dried forget-me-not in her pocket watch, shimmering with bright blue light as if it were picked only a day earlier.

artifacts.name: Touch of Rekos
artifacts.description: An artifact handed down by the god Rekos after the Spirit Shrine was built. It is said that this item, containing the power of a god, is bestowed upon the most qualified shaman.

artifacts.name: Doctor's Bag
artifacts.description: A bag filled with medications that Ray made himself. Most illnesses and injuries can be treated by the medications within the bag.

artifacts.name: Guardian Ice Crystals
artifacts.description: Emilia forms ice crystals to protect those she holds dear.

artifacts.name: Flawless Garments
artifacts.description: Shuna made these clothes based on the clothing worn in Ritania using her skill, Analytic (Comprehender). It's perfection, both functionally and aesthetically.

artifacts.name: Sacred Tree Branch
artifacts.description: A sacred object pilgrims use when performing a ceremony. It's made from a portion of a giant sacred tree that existed in the past. It is said that this object amplifies the bearer's foresight ability and allows them to take a peek at the future's various possibilities.

artifacts.name: EXIF Detective (E.d.) Gadget
artifacts.description: One of ae-NINGNING's multiple hacking tools that allows her to track all sorts of metadata. It is also known as E.d., which shares the same name as the hacker group she's affiliated with.

artifacts.name: Fan of Light and Dark
artifacts.description: One of the objects that Spirit Lord Noias gifted to the Shadow Elves in the past. When the Shadow Elves settled down in Natalon, Silvana also blessed it with their energy.

artifacts.name: Sole Consolation
artifacts.description: "When I'm with you, you make me forget all the hardships." Sometimes the small bit of warmth at one's fingertips can be more comforting than any words.

artifacts.name: Bird's-Eye View
artifacts.description: A family heirloom and weapon passed down through generations in Birgitta's family, known for their long history as famous information brokers. It symbolizes a crucial lesson that they should always remain observers, making level-headed decisions by viewing situations from a distance.

artifacts.name: Spotted Mouse Hair Tie
artifacts.description: A hair tie Choux gave to Frida as a gift to keep her long hair from getting wet. Although at first, Frida complained that only a kid would use something like this, she secretly loves it.

artifacts.name: Homage to Tarman
artifacts.description: A luxurious, customized pen that once belonged to the former king, Tarman. It was mounted on a specially designed display stand, but Schniel has been using it as his dedicated signing pen since taking the throne. "Tools are meant to be used for their purpose, not worshipped. Even a nation’s king must abide by this rule."

artifacts.name: Proof of Friendship
artifacts.description: An emerald-jeweled accessory made by Alencia as a birthday gift for Young Senya. When Young Senya uses in times of danger, she can summon Alencia.

artifacts.name: Proof of Love
artifacts.description: These snake fangs crave Fenne, but she believes it's just Papa's way of showing love.

artifacts.name: Queen’s Whistle
artifacts.description: The glistening seafoam rolling with the waves, and the sun-scorched sands... It’s always around this time of year that the girl is reminded of a certain traumatic experience.

artifacts.name: Cure-All Magic Wand
artifacts.description: A real-life version of the all-healing magic wand from the children’s anime Healing Angel Lidica, casually referenced by Yuna. No one knows how it really works, but it is without a doubt able to cure ailments.\n“I’m certain that I can cure any illness with this magic wand! But, if I want to use it... I should make sure someone is sick first, right?”

artifacts.name: Veritas
artifacts.description: “No matter how hard you try, you cannot hide it. The truth always lingers in the scent.”\nA special perfume crafted by Perfumer Byblis. It is said that anyone who inhales its scent will speak the truth.

artifacts.name: Excommunicant's Censer
artifacts.description: "Goddess, have mercy on us."\nThe day she turned her back on fate, and the night she prayed the most earnestly.

exclusive_equipment.name: Ruele's Sad Promise
exclusive_equipment.description: A mysterious concoction of life created by combining the laws of light and nature and the love of a noble soul.

exclusive_equipment.name: Prototype Crown
exclusive_equipment.description: Equipment that contains a set of emergency commands and looks like a tiny crown.

exclusive_equipment.name: Valkyrie Wing
exclusive_equipment.description: A mysterious circlet that symbolizes strength and beauty, and is the source of Rose's Fighting Spirit.

exclusive_equipment.name: Dun Blyraia's Dark Blessing
exclusive_equipment.description: A quiver made with Mana from the dimension that Wanderer Silk came from, known to maximize her concentration.

exclusive_equipment.name: Small Drone Tuna
exclusive_equipment.description: Tuna is a drone made by Yuna. No matter where she goes, on Earth or on Orbis, Tuna is there to protect her.

exclusive_equipment.name: Small Drone Tuna
exclusive_equipment.description: Tuna is a drone made by Yuna. No matter where she goes, on Earth or on Orbis, Tuna is there to protect her.

exclusive_equipment.name: Small Drone Tuna
exclusive_equipment.description: Tuna is a drone made by Yuna. No matter where she goes, on Earth or on Orbis, Tuna is there to protect her.

exclusive_equipment.name: Small Drone Tuna
exclusive_equipment.description: Tuna is a drone made by Yuna. No matter where she goes, on Earth or on Orbis, Tuna is there to protect her.

exclusive_equipment.name: Whispered Faith
exclusive_equipment.description: A mystical whistle that enables the user to freely exchange feelings with small creatures.

exclusive_equipment.name: Golden Cat's Treasure
exclusive_equipment.description: An ear-protecting ornament that was passed down in Armin's family and brings wealth and honor.

exclusive_equipment.name: Azure Dragon's Spirit
exclusive_equipment.description: A ribbon with special powers that allows the wearer to harness their innate dragon powers.

exclusive_equipment.name: Justice's Mask
exclusive_equipment.description: A pauldron with the face of a stern judge, symbolizing the firm resolve not to allow emotion to get in the way of duty.

exclusive_equipment.name: Hellfire
exclusive_equipment.description: A gauntlet that maximizes the power of Malicus, making it unsuitable for cooking.

exclusive_equipment.name: Estyria
exclusive_equipment.description: A beautiful, silver sword that cuts through its enemies delicately, like the winter wind.

exclusive_equipment.name: Witch Hat
exclusive_equipment.description: A magic hat that keeps your skin clear and wrinkle-free by completely blocking heat and UV rays.

exclusive_equipment.name: Witch Hat
exclusive_equipment.description: A magic hat that keeps your skin clear and wrinkle-free by completely blocking heat and UV rays.

exclusive_equipment.name: Witch Hat
exclusive_equipment.description: A magic hat that keeps your skin clear and wrinkle-free by completely blocking heat and UV rays.

exclusive_equipment.name: Witch Hat
exclusive_equipment.description: A magic hat that keeps your skin clear and wrinkle-free by completely blocking heat and UV rays.

exclusive_equipment.name: Citrine Treasure
exclusive_equipment.description: A beautiful brooch made by the world's greatest artisan using only the highest-grade materials.

exclusive_equipment.name: Lucky Dice
exclusive_equipment.description: Dice used on the day Cermia won a once-in-a-lifetime jackpot. She holds onto them in hopes that they'll bring her that luck again one day.

exclusive_equipment.name: Tear-Stained Badge
exclusive_equipment.description: A worn-out badge made of paper and given to General Purrgis by his subordinates as a token of their appreciation for him.

exclusive_equipment.name: Grudge Marble
exclusive_equipment.description: A marble filled with the grudges of people who pledged their souls and loyalty to Kayron

exclusive_equipment.name: Eternal Rose
exclusive_equipment.description: A rose that Lidica picked when she was excommunicated from the Rose Apostles. It has been specially treated to ensure it never withers but also lost its scent in the process.

exclusive_equipment.name: A Treatise on Logic
exclusive_equipment.description: An old book found in the royal library. Other than Romann, nobody has read it in a very long time.

exclusive_equipment.name: Shadow Wing
exclusive_equipment.description: A circlet shaped like a pair of wings and consumed by an inner shadow. It reinvigorates the distorted desires of its wearer with new life.

exclusive_equipment.name: Queen's Keepsake
exclusive_equipment.description: The only gift Sigret has ever received. Though little more than a decoration, she wears it daily.

exclusive_equipment.name: Untainted Heart
exclusive_equipment.description: A staff decorated with a bright red orb that encapsulates both the spirit of charity, and the unwavering determination of Achates.

exclusive_equipment.name: Silver Lion's Protection
exclusive_equipment.description: A shield with a lion motif regarded by Troublemaker Crozet as his most valued possession, which he uses in honor of his one true love.

exclusive_equipment.name: Soul Tailor
exclusive_equipment.description: A medal bestowed only to the most talented of tailors. As it is a family heirloom, Lilibet received it from her mother, with whom she has been separated from childhood.

exclusive_equipment.name: True Sight
exclusive_equipment.description: An object that has been passed down among the greatest sorcerers since ancient times. It is said that even in total darkness, its blue light does not fade.

exclusive_equipment.name: Communion Lotus
exclusive_equipment.description: A physical manifestation of the power gained through communion with the Spirits. Its form and nature change as needed.

exclusive_equipment.name: Flame of Life
exclusive_equipment.description: When Ravi was reborn as a wraith, fire energy was infused into her body, deriving its strength from the lives taken by her axe.

exclusive_equipment.name: Proof of Choice
exclusive_equipment.description: A token given to the leader of the Enhanced Magic Division. To ensure the past is never forgotten, he keeps it with him at all times.

exclusive_equipment.name: Black Winter Spear
exclusive_equipment.description: "A requiem for the fallen heroes of Wintenberg." These are the words the blacksmith spoke as he offered this weapon to Cecilia.

exclusive_equipment.name: Rin's Sparkling Rings
exclusive_equipment.description: A pair of rings Basar gave Rin on her first birthday after he adopted her. They never lose their sheen, and they're much lighter than her other rings.

exclusive_equipment.name: Reingar PSC Armband
exclusive_equipment.description: An armband Celine wore when she was a part of the Reingar Public Security Club. She keeps it with her to help remind her of those days.

exclusive_equipment.name: Dragon Emerald
exclusive_equipment.description: Jewelry that Luna's father passed on to her. It is the only thing her mother left behind when she left.

exclusive_equipment.name: A Rabbit's Wild Nature
exclusive_equipment.description: A whip used to train beasts. It is said that beasts are more obedient when tamed with this whip.

exclusive_equipment.name: Silent Daggers
exclusive_equipment.description: A pair of daggers that Assassin Coli has been using since before she joined the Dagger Sicar.

exclusive_equipment.name: Silver Belt of Determination
exclusive_equipment.description: A belt Pavel received as a gift from a guard in Perland when he was young. He used to look at this belt and dream of becoming a Perland soldier someday.

exclusive_equipment.name: Hidden Nature Mace
exclusive_equipment.description: A weapon infused with the true nature of the battle-driven nun. Clarissa strongly believes that it will lead the souls of the fallen to the Goddess.

exclusive_equipment.name: Moon's Judgment
exclusive_equipment.description: The weapon Kise uses that is infused with Lunaris's power. She delivers fair judgments with a swing of this scythe's cold, sharp blade.

exclusive_equipment.name: Everlasting Lapis
exclusive_equipment.description: A gemstone Nocturnes use to make their amulets. The hardness of the stone symbolizes an unshakable mind.

exclusive_equipment.name: Little Queen's Guard
exclusive_equipment.description: The pauldron Charlotte wears over top of her cape. To Charlotte, it symbolizes the weight that a queen must bear.

exclusive_equipment.name: Frigid Spirit
exclusive_equipment.description: The spear that Mort always wields. Its bluish glow grows brighter as Mort's rage intensifies.

exclusive_equipment.name: Emblem of the Holy Order of the Blue Cross
exclusive_equipment.description: A hat worn by Angelica, the High Priestess of the Holy Order of the Blue Cross. It is said that what the high priestess wears depends on their taste in fashion.

exclusive_equipment.name: Snowy Mountain Horn
exclusive_equipment.description: A horn Choux's dad made to protect Choux from the dangers of the mountain. Whenever Choux blows this horn during an emergency, Cream appears and saves her.

exclusive_equipment.name: Silent Green Flash
exclusive_equipment.description: A green marble in which Assassin Cartuja stores his power. During battles, the concentrated power can be released in order to strike down enemies instantly.

exclusive_equipment.name: Bag of Sweet Treats
exclusive_equipment.description: The most precious bag in the world. This bag is filled to the brim with treats given by those who have fallen in love with Clarissa.

exclusive_equipment.name: Grace of Lightning
exclusive_equipment.description: The pauldron that Mort granted to Senya. This pauldron shines as bright as lightning as the wearer's rage deepens.

exclusive_equipment.name: Blade Insignia
exclusive_equipment.description: An insignia that was awarded to the best Knight in the Dayern family. It's quite heavy because it's made of pure gold.

exclusive_equipment.name: Sword of the Righteous Path
exclusive_equipment.description: A sword that was handed down from Celine. Both Celine and Karin have their names engraved on the hilt.

exclusive_equipment.name: Bloody Jewel
exclusive_equipment.description: A stone with an odd power that has been handed down to the queen of Wintenberg for generations.

exclusive_equipment.name: The Price of Insolence
exclusive_equipment.description: Gauntlets made using heavy metal. Most people find them difficult to lift.

exclusive_equipment.name: Crimson Earrings
exclusive_equipment.description: Beautiful earrings with a rare magical gem embedded within them. Tieria cherishes them with her life.

exclusive_equipment.name: Shadow King Plushie
exclusive_equipment.description: A plush toy Tenebria got from a festival. She enjoys keeping it with her to see Kayron bothered by the way she treats the plushie that resembles him.

exclusive_equipment.name: Lord's Coffin
exclusive_equipment.description: A coffin infused with the condensed power of the Vampire Lord. The deep darkness will not allow even the faintest stream of light.

exclusive_equipment.name: Purest Flame
exclusive_equipment.description: A weapon that takes the shape of a blue flame. It emits a light that sways like that of a candle's flame.

exclusive_equipment.name: Guide of Holy Brilliance
exclusive_equipment.description: An accessory Elena was given after becoming the high priestess of Constella. With its light, it guides her even through the darkest of nights.

exclusive_equipment.name: Flawless Wings
exclusive_equipment.description: A staff decorated with wings symbolizing the healing wind. It heals all diseases and wounds with its refreshing breeze.

exclusive_equipment.name: The Watcher's Monocle
exclusive_equipment.description: A monocle that aims at the target with perfect accuracy. Any target captured by his lens will not be able to dodge his bullets.

exclusive_equipment.name: Halted Pocketwatch
exclusive_equipment.description: Diene's pocketwatch where she keeps a dried forget-me-not inside. The watch's hands are halted at the exact time of Diene's most beautiful moment of her life.

exclusive_equipment.name: A Spell of Tragic Love
exclusive_equipment.description: A talisman given by Amid long ago. Though it does not have any noticeable effects, Zahhak cherishes it more than anything.

exclusive_equipment.name: Flame Armband
exclusive_equipment.description: A golden armband Inferno Khawazu inherited from his mother. It is said that the armband does not deform even in the hottest of flames.

exclusive_equipment.name: Cape of Selfish Interest
exclusive_equipment.description: A cape Baal made for Sezan after she became a doll. Baal is keeping it in his pocket, looking forward to her reaction when she sees it.

exclusive_equipment.name: Scarlet Tear
exclusive_equipment.description: Earrings bestowed to Aramintha from a nomad during her travels with Duren. No one knew that the trip was going to be their last one together.

exclusive_equipment.name: Restrained Ferality
exclusive_equipment.description: A necklace given to Cidd by the Wild Dog Company after he accomplished his first mission. Apparently, Jenua picked the design himself.

exclusive_equipment.name: Golden Horn of Vengeance
exclusive_equipment.description: A slingshot he bought after selling everything that he inherited from his parents. He reconfigured the handle as a flute so that he can call Racoo.

exclusive_equipment.name: Indomitable Faith
exclusive_equipment.description: A crossbow made from the weapon Furious had used when he was serving with the Aakhen Army. It can shoot dozens of arrows within a short period.

exclusive_equipment.name: Prototype Memory Card
exclusive_equipment.description: A memory card that was installed in Laika when she was first produced. Brinus gave it to her in a small gift box and told her to go through its contents whenever Laika felt the need.

exclusive_equipment.name: Blood Choker
exclusive_equipment.description: A choker Haste has been wearing ever since the day he ended up alone. He always feels an unquenchable thirst.

exclusive_equipment.name: Nana's Game Console
exclusive_equipment.description: A game console that Nana made all by herself. Its background picture is a selfie of her in a ponytail.

exclusive_equipment.name: Death-Rattling Axes
exclusive_equipment.description: A pair of axes that Assassin Cidd's boss from the other world gave to him. He often uses them to chop firewood.

exclusive_equipment.name: Grace of the Vast Ocean Tide
exclusive_equipment.description: A shield touched by a Guardian's breath. Krau's shield is full of traces of fierce battles he has fought.

exclusive_equipment.name: Beads of Mystic Spirits
exclusive_equipment.description: Prayer beads worn by Sharun, the high shaman of the royal palace. They say it emits a mysterious light in the dark of night.

exclusive_equipment.name: Best Friend, Pippy
exclusive_equipment.description: A doll that a young girl made and brought around with her everywhere she went. Pippy has listened to all of that girl's stories.

exclusive_equipment.name: Foreign Minister's Baton
exclusive_equipment.description: A baton with Politia's national flag attached to it. When Flan is in a good mood, she often performs flag magic for Landy.

exclusive_equipment.name: Asura
exclusive_equipment.description: A sword that Milim uses when in battle mode. It is said to have been used to slay countless majin and demon lords.

exclusive_equipment.name: Asura
exclusive_equipment.description: A sword that Milim uses when in battle mode. It is said to have been used to slay countless majin and demon lords.

exclusive_equipment.name: Asura
exclusive_equipment.description: A sword that Milim uses when in battle mode. It is said to have been used to slay countless majin and demon lords.

exclusive_equipment.name: Shuna's Shuttle
exclusive_equipment.description: One of the tools Shuna uses when weaving cloth, allowing her to work with any material delicately.

exclusive_equipment.name: Shuna's Shuttle
exclusive_equipment.description: One of the tools Shuna uses when weaving cloth, allowing her to work with any material delicately.

exclusive_equipment.name: Shuna's Shuttle
exclusive_equipment.description: One of the tools Shuna uses when weaving cloth, allowing her to work with any material delicately.

exclusive_equipment.name: Sempiternal Safflower
exclusive_equipment.description: A hair band her father gave her when she was a child. To this day, it's Tempest Surin's most cherished memory.

exclusive_equipment.name: Waltz of Waves
exclusive_equipment.description: A pareo designed by an Ezeran artisan. The way it flutters as Bellona walks seems as if waves are dancing the waltz.

exclusive_equipment.name: Bunny Headphones
exclusive_equipment.description: Challenger Dominiel's custom-made wireless Headphones. Its noise-canceling function allows her to ignore whatever she prefers not to hear.

exclusive_equipment.name: Royal Prosperity
exclusive_equipment.description: An insignia that symbolizes the Perlutia family. Lilias has been keeping it with her since the very first day of her training as the Citylord.

exclusive_equipment.name: Advent of Destruction
exclusive_equipment.description: Gloves specially modified by Hwayoung. The wearer requires considerable physical strength to use them, as their weight doubles during training.

exclusive_equipment.name: Eternal Red Heart
exclusive_equipment.description: A charm made of leaves from the Autumn Leaves Tree, the Sacred Tree of Tranquil Prairie. It was awarded to the victor of the Tournament of the Autumn Sword Protector, along with the Autumn Sword.

exclusive_equipment.name: Blooming Rose
exclusive_equipment.description: Abigail's bracelet that glows scarlet when using blood magic. It bloomed on her wrist the day Kane bestowed her with his power.

exclusive_equipment.name: Bad Cat Stamp
exclusive_equipment.description: A giant stamp that Armin, the representative of the fashion brand Bad Cat, uses to seal deals. It's inspired by the design of a perfume that she launched in the past.

exclusive_equipment.name: Willful Bells of Sanctity
exclusive_equipment.description: Bells that Beehoo always carries with him in remembrance of Silvana's will, which has always longed for peace. To keep them on him at all times, he has turned them into an accessory that attaches to his waist.

exclusive_equipment.name: Boss's Coat
exclusive_equipment.description: A coat that the subordinates of Dagger Sicar all chipped in to buy. Although he may not say it out loud, it is Eligos's most cherished treasure.

exclusive_equipment.name: Crown of Pyrokinesis
exclusive_equipment.description: A hair accessory that embodies blazing flames, with a design that's more decorative than it is practical.

exclusive_equipment.name: Prophet's Shawl
exclusive_equipment.description: A shawl fluttering lightly like a flying Dragon, embroidered with a golden Dragon that symbolizes wisdom.

exclusive_equipment.name: Chain of Remembrance
exclusive_equipment.description: A sword ornament gifted by her aunt, Celine. Each time she repairs the worn-out ornament, Karin once again vows to avenge Celine.

exclusive_equipment.name: Wand of Misguided Protection
exclusive_equipment.description: The magic wand wielded by Benevolent Romann. It moves solely to secure the victory of his liege, Ervalen.

exclusive_equipment.name: Kroscilla's Frost
exclusive_equipment.description: An icy sword Kroscilla gifted Lethe. Upon accepting it, Lethe's heart slowly turned into a block of cold ice. Anyone other than its rightful owner who dares touch it will find their hands slowly freeze, as if gripped by frostbite.

exclusive_equipment.name: Blood Blade
exclusive_equipment.description: A cursed sword that is said to have consumed the soul of a swordsman who followed a forbidden path for the sake of vengeance. The vengeful spirit grants immense power to its wielder by entering their body and possessing them.

exclusive_equipment.name: Blooming Lotus
exclusive_equipment.description: A guard that Hwayoung prepared after injuring her arms. It has a small compartment to store ointment, snacks, and some money.

exclusive_equipment.name: Alexa's Gift
exclusive_equipment.description: A dagger Alexa gifted to Iseria. It came with a booklet explaining that the dagger once held the power to connect or sever connections, but now only a vestige of that power remains.

exclusive_equipment.name: Time of Tales
exclusive_equipment.description: A watch that controls time in the land of fairy tales. And with the power of the stars, it can even shroud the whole world in eternal darkness.

exclusive_equipment.name: Regal Crown
exclusive_equipment.description: A helmet adorning Immortal Wukong's forehead. It is both sturdy and dignified in appearance.

exclusive_equipment.name: Sword of Rapture
exclusive_equipment.description: A sword that grants its bearer delight and amusement. It is tainted by the dark power of a carnivorous plant.

exclusive_equipment.name: Sealed Energy
exclusive_equipment.description: An apostle's power dwelling in Sez's right hand. Though this dark force allowed him to escape the Homunculus laboratory, it continues to haunt him.

exclusive_equipment.name: Protective Pistol
exclusive_equipment.description: A pistol infused with the resolve to protect the human realm. It’s said bullets imbued with the power of the new moon can pose a great threat to Vampires.

exclusive_equipment.name: Robe of Concealment
exclusive_equipment.description: A robe worn by Infinite Horizon Achates to conceal herself from the world. This white garment, which veils the wearer's face, not only ensures complete privacy but also exudes a mysterious aura.

exclusive_equipment.name: Binding Knot
exclusive_equipment.description: An ornament designed to suppress her innate violence. It guides her in choosing the right moment to unsheathe her blade, in accordance with the promise she made to her grandfather.

exclusive_equipment.name: Flower of Oblation
exclusive_equipment.description: One spring day, Amid completed the ceremonial ritual to dedicate herself to her tribe, pinning the gifted flower in her hair. It stands as a Shadow Elf shaman’s eternal vow to uphold the sacred promise.

exclusive_equipment.name: Storyteller’s Compass
exclusive_equipment.description: A compass that guides the wandering story collector to the right path. Though some have noticed the needle spinning on its own, no repair shop has ever found a problem with it...leaving the mystery unsolved.

exclusive_equipment.name: Wind Ring
exclusive_equipment.description: A clothing accessory personally bestowed upon Yulha by Silvana. It was prepared with Yulha specifically in mind because of her natural affinity with metals. Even when she became a Great Wicked, she could not bring herself to part with this piece.

exclusive_equipment.name: Super Cute Shield
exclusive_equipment.description: The shield that Crimson Armin carries around all the time, as if it were a part of her body. Many people are often misled by how easily Crimson Armin waves around the adorably decorated shield, but some already know that it’s far too heavy and sturdy for even an ogre to handle.

exclusive_equipment.name: Shooting Star Popping Candy
exclusive_equipment.description: An ice cream named by Luluca. The sweet blend of candy toppings and cool vanilla ice cream drives away the summer heat.

exclusive_equipment.name: Mystic Cyclops Hairpin
exclusive_equipment.description: A hairpin that moves in tune with Laia’s feelings. It was once the familiar she tamed, but with her memories gone, she no longer remembers.

exclusive_equipment.name: Everlasting Faith
exclusive_equipment.description: A robust shield typical of early-generation units, equipped with an internal cannon meant to quickly neutralize threats in critical situations.

exclusive_equipment.name: Guard Knight’s Gauntlet
exclusive_equipment.description: Part of the plate armor Derek Hilag gifted Krau upon inducting him into the guard. The rest of it was tossed carelessly in his quarters because it was too much trouble to put on.

exclusive_equipment.name: Twin Fish Blades
exclusive_equipment.description: Charlotte’s ultimate weapons—the Tuna Blade and the Marlin Blade. She eagerly prepared them for her first trip with her friends. The Marlin Blade can even be used as a surfboard.

exclusive_equipment.name: Gemstone Earrings
exclusive_equipment.description: Earrings made from gemstones Fumyr collected herself and infused with magic. A brilliant, sparkling glow comes as a bonus.

exclusive_equipment.name: Noblewoman's Pearl
exclusive_equipment.description: A pearl lace choker necklace belonging to a noblewoman who was once called a magnate in Skuggiheim. Just wearing it creates a glamorous and elegant atmosphere. According to gossips, there is a rumor that it makes its owner rich. Nobody knows how Birgitta got her hands on it.

exclusive_equipment.name: Reaper's Cloak
exclusive_equipment.description: The cloak Hecate always wears. Decorated with the feathers of a black bird of paradise, and considered a treasure by the royal family of Tartarus, it is said to have excellent thermal insulation.

exclusive_equipment.name: Window of All Creation
exclusive_equipment.description: A mirror imbued with the power of Aheldad that allows one to peek into other dimensions. When reaching her hand into the mirror, Lua's body reaches there faster than light.

exclusive_equipment.name: Primeval Diadem
exclusive_equipment.description: A token that has been passed down to the elders of Dun Blyraia. It is said that it was hanging on a young branch of the World Tree on the day the first elder was appointed.

exclusive_equipment.name: It's Senya's
exclusive_equipment.description: A ribbon with Senya's name written on it. It securely holds her trademark ponytail in place. No matter how much she runs and rolls around, her cuteness remains undisturbed.

exclusive_equipment.name: Wake of Courage
exclusive_equipment.description: A jet ski that helps Hwayoung forget the fear gnawing at her. The sensation of speeding across the surface of the water instills her with the courage to move forward once again.

exclusive_equipment.name: Archdemon's Eye
exclusive_equipment.description: Proof of the best swordsman, now corrupted after taking in the power of the Archdemon. The ominous light that occasionally sparkles serves as a reminder of his irreversible betrayal.

exclusive_equipment.name: Witch's Crown of Thorns
exclusive_equipment.description: Only the pain from her crown of thorns can free her from a cursed, excruciating life.

exclusive_equipment.name: Mirror of Desire
exclusive_equipment.description: A pendant that controls the emotions of lifeforms. It contains the agony of devastated people, trapped in an illusion that reveals their ugly nature.

exclusive_equipment.name: Cross of Proof
exclusive_equipment.description: A cross-shaped decoration gifted to the best specimen by a researcher. However, it secretly houses a magical tracking device emitting the location of the specimen.

exclusive_equipment.name: Abyssal Eye of Kal
exclusive_equipment.description: Otherworldly knowledge from an unknown source, written in illegible scribbles that could drive one to insanity at a mere glimpse.

exclusive_equipment.name: Cream Pastry Scouter
exclusive_equipment.description: Smart glasses linked to the main server that controls the Cream Pastry Legion. It also has a function to read the opponent’s power level.

exclusive_equipment.name: Phantom Armor
exclusive_equipment.description: Armor imbued with the ability to control the souls of the deceased. The orb set into the armor contains souls accumulated from contracts with previous bearers. Only those who prove themselves worthy may call upon its power.

exclusive_equipment.name: Star Extinction
exclusive_equipment.description: A blade bestowed upon Straze by the evil god Fastus through deceit. It holds enough power to annihilate stars, and is embedded with an eye that surveils its host.

exclusive_equipment.name: Roar of the Victor
exclusive_equipment.description: A shoulder sash that symbolizes the glory of the King of Conquerors. Its golden lion decoration radiates the majesty of one who conquered an entire continent.

exclusive_equipment.name: Constraint of Absolute Power
exclusive_equipment.description: A gauntlet that can meticulously control the life-siphoning side effects of donning the Black Hand of the Goddess. It is durable enough to withstand any force that comes its way.

exclusive_equipment.name: Rabbit Fortune Cookie Pouch
exclusive_equipment.description: A rabbit cookie said to bring luck and warm light to those who receive it. Even on the battlefield, Ruele's cookie becomes a shield that protects the hearts of her companions.

exclusive_equipment.name: Extermination Protocol
exclusive_equipment.description: A combat drone designed by Friedrich for Sigret. It is equipped with lethal algorithms optimized for the sole purpose of annihilating its targets.

exclusive_equipment.name: War God’s Deliverance
exclusive_equipment.description: A divine axe handed down to those chosen by the heavens. It contains the sealed power of an Evil Dragon that once opposed the War God, and only Ravi can wield its burning weight with ease.

exclusive_equipment.name: Proof of Authority
exclusive_equipment.description: An armband signifying Aria’s role as a Disciplinary Prefect at Shadewood High. The crimson afterimage it traces during Aria’s punishments is forever burned into the minds of violators.

exclusive_equipment.name: Azure Blade of Spring Thunder
exclusive_equipment.description: A demonic heirloom passed down through generations of the Seasons Gang’s leaders. Legend has it that those possessed by the demon dwelling within the blade become a sura.

exclusive_equipment.name: Homage to Rekos
exclusive_equipment.description: A newly designed bracelet from Blooming Lily. Inspired by Rekos, the lost homeland of Luluca.

exclusive_equipment.name: Cloud-Veiled Crimson Moon
exclusive_equipment.description: As the crimson moon emerges from the clouds, its radiance becomes an inescapable strike. The fan conceals Lone Crescent Bellona’s true intent while amplifying the elegance of her movements.

exclusive_equipment.name: Prophet of the Waves
exclusive_equipment.description: A legendary spirit stone that is said to reveal the capricious Sea God's temper and the location of treasures slumbering deep in the ocean. Flan dismisses the rumors, claiming it's just an imitation. However, watching her navigate through fierce waves to find treasure, the legend doesn't seem to be an exaggeration.

exclusive_equipment.name: Aithernum Regnum
exclusive_equipment.description: The eternity of the nation comes before any other value. The insignia inherited from his adoptive father was as solid as that oath, shining brightly without wavering.

exclusive_equipment.name: A Queen's Responsibility
exclusive_equipment.description: Never turning a blind eye to something that harms her people. The little queen considered this the most noble responsibility given to a monarch.

exclusive_equipment.name: Escapee's Whip Sword
exclusive_equipment.description: A longsword used to cut down fanatics on the day she broke the shackles of a cult and escaped. When enemies try to avoid close combat, the sword turns into a whip, binding them and bringing them to their knees.

materials.name: Flame Rune
materials.description: A Rune for Awakening Fire elemental Heroes obtainable from the Flame Spirit Altar.

materials.name: Greater Flame Rune

materials.name: Epic Flame Rune

materials.name: Frost Rune
materials.description: A Rune for Awakening Ice elemental Heroes obtainable from the Frost Spirit Altar.

materials.description: A Rune for Awakening Ice elemental Heroes obtainable from the Frost Spirit Altar Normal difficulty and above.

materials.name: Epic Frost Rune
materials.description: A Rune for Awakening Ice elemental Heroes obtainable from the Frost Spirit Altar Hard difficulty and above.

materials.name: Life Rune
materials.description: A Rune for Awakening Earth elemental Heroes obtainable from the Forest Spirit Altar.

materials.name: Greater Life Rune
materials.description: A Rune for Awakening Earth elemental Heroes obtainable from the Forest Spirit Altar Normal difficulty and above.
